words.definition: To be a sign that something, often bad, is going to happen. (IELTS ≈ signal · foreshadow · be an early sign of · herald)
words.definitionUz: be a harbinger of — biror narsa, ko'pincha yomon narsa, yuz berishining belgisi bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The sudden fall in bee numbers may be a harbinger of wider ecological collapse.
words.example1Translation: Asalarilar sonining to'satdan kamayishi kengroq ekologik inqirozning darakchisi bo'lishi mumkin.
words.example2: Losing bees could be an early warning that whole ecosystems are failing.
words.example2Translation: Asalarilarning yo'qolishi butun ekotizimlar buzilayotganining ilk ogohlantirishi bo'lishi mumkin.
words.example3: Rising debt is often a harbinger of economic trouble.
words.example3Translation: Qarzning o'sishi ko'pincha iqtisodiy muammolarning darakchisi bo'ladi.

words.definition: To start a process or series of events. (IELTS ≈ set in motion · initiate · trigger · get under way)
words.definitionUz: set in train — jarayon yoki voqealar zanjirini boshlab bermoq.
words.example1: The minister's resignation set in train a series of political crises.
words.example1Translation: Vazirning iste'fosi bir qator siyosiy inqirozlarni boshlab yubordi.
words.example2: One resignation led to crisis after crisis in government.
words.example2Translation: Bitta iste'fo hukumatda ketma-ket inqirozlarga olib keldi.
words.example3: The report set in train a full review of safety rules.
words.example3Translation: Hisobot xavfsizlik qoidalarini to'liq qayta ko'rib chiqishni boshlab berdi.

words.definition: To depend on something else happening. (IELTS ≈ depend on · be conditional on · hinge on · rest on)
words.definitionUz: be contingent upon — boshqa narsa yuz berishiga bog'liq bo'lmoq.
words.example1: Further funding is contingent upon the success of the first trial.
words.example1Translation: Qo'shimcha mablag' birinchi sinov muvaffaqiyatiga bog'liq.
words.example2: More money will only be given if the first test works.
words.example2Translation: Birinchi sinov ish bersagina ko'proq pul beriladi.
words.example3: The offer is contingent upon a satisfactory medical report.
words.example3Translation: Taklif qoniqarli tibbiy xulosaga bog'liq.

words.definition: To come into existence because it was badly needed. (IELTS ≈ arise from need · emerge out of necessity)
words.definitionUz: be born of necessity — qattiq ehtiyoj tufayli paydo bo'lmoq.
words.example1: Many inventions were born of necessity during the war.
words.example1Translation: Urush davrida ko'plab ixtirolar zaruratdan tug'ilgan.
words.example2: Wartime shortages forced people to create new devices.
words.example2Translation: Urush davridagi tanqisliklar odamlarni yangi qurilmalar yaratishga majbur qildi.
words.example3: Their friendship was born of necessity rather than choice.
words.example3Translation: Ularning do'stligi tanlovdan emas, zaruratdan tug'ilgan.

words.definition: To have a strong effect that spreads widely over a period of time. (IELTS ≈ spread through · echo across · have repercussions throughout)
words.definitionUz: reverberate through — keng tarqaladigan kuchli ta'sirga ega bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The bank's collapse reverberated through the global economy.
words.example1Translation: Bankning qulashi jahon iqtisodiyoti bo'ylab aks-sado berdi.
words.example2: The failure of one bank affected economies around the world.
words.example2Translation: Bitta bankning barbod bo'lishi butun dunyo iqtisodiyotiga ta'sir qildi.
words.example3: The decision will reverberate through the industry for years.
words.example3Translation: Qaror yillar davomida soha bo'ylab aks-sado beradi.

words.definition: To make a difficult situation even worse. (IELTS ≈ worsen the situation · exacerbate the problem · add to the difficulty)
words.definitionUz: compound the predicament — qiyin vaziyatni yanada yomonlashtirmoq.
words.example1: A second drought compounded the farmers' predicament.
words.example1Translation: Ikkinchi qurg'oqchilik fermerlarning og'ir ahvolini yanada chigallashtirdi.
words.example2: Another dry year made things even harder for the farmers.
words.example2Translation: Yana bir qurg'oqchil yil fermerlarga vaziyatni yanada qiyinlashtirdi.
words.example3: Rising interest rates compounded the predicament of indebted families.
words.example3Translation: Foiz stavkalarining oshishi qarzdor oilalarning ahvolini yanada og'irlashtirdi.

words.definition: A prediction that comes true because people believe it. (IELTS ≈ a prediction that causes itself · an expectation that creates its outcome)
words.definitionUz: a self-fulfilling prophecy — odamlar ishongani uchun amalga oshadigan bashorat.
words.example1: Fear of a bank collapse can become a self-fulfilling prophecy.
words.example1Translation: Bank qulashidan qo'rquv o'z-o'zini ro'yobga chiqaradigan bashoratga aylanishi mumkin.
words.example2: If everyone expects a bank to fail and withdraws money, it really does fail.
words.example2Translation: Hamma bank qulaydi deb pulini olsa, u haqiqatan ham quladi.
words.example3: Low expectations of pupils can be a self-fulfilling prophecy.
words.example3Translation: O'quvchilardan kam kutish o'z-o'zini ro'yobga chiqaradigan bashorat bo'lishi mumkin.

words.definition: To be closely connected so that one affects the other. (IELTS ≈ be closely linked with · be bound up with · be interwoven with)
words.definitionUz: be intertwined with — biri ikkinchisiga ta'sir qiladigan darajada yaqin bog'liq bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The city's history is intertwined with the river.
words.example1Translation: Shahar tarixi daryo bilan chambarchas bog'langan.
words.example2: You cannot separate the city's past from the river's story.
words.example2Translation: Shahar o'tmishini daryo tarixidan ajratib bo'lmaydi.
words.example3: Economic and environmental problems are deeply intertwined.
words.example3Translation: Iqtisodiy va ekologik muammolar bir-biri bilan chuqur bog'langan.

words.definition: To make the effect of something less strong. (IELTS ≈ soften the effect of · cushion · lessen · dampen)
words.definitionUz: blunt the impact of — biror narsaning ta'sirini kamroq kuchli qilmoq.
words.example1: Government subsidies helped blunt the impact of rising fuel prices.
words.example1Translation: Davlat subsidiyalari yoqilg'i narxlari oshishi ta'sirini yumshatishga yordam berdi.
words.example2: State payments made the higher fuel costs easier to bear.
words.example2Translation: Davlat to'lovlari yoqilg'ining qimmatlashuvini ko'tarishni osonlashtirdi.
words.example3: Sea walls can blunt the impact of storms.
words.example3Translation: Dengiz to'siqlari bo'ronlar ta'sirini yumshatishi mumkin.

words.definition: To suddenly cause a large amount of something, such as criticism. (IELTS ≈ provoke a flood of · trigger a wave of · release a stream of)
words.definitionUz: unleash a torrent of — to'satdan juda ko'p narsaga, masalan tanqidga, sabab bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The announcement unleashed a torrent of criticism online.
words.example1Translation: E'lon internetda sel kabi tanqidlar oqimini qo'zg'atdi.
words.example2: After the news, huge numbers of people complained online.
words.example2Translation: Xabardan keyin juda ko'p odam internetda shikoyat qildi.
words.example3: The film unleashed a torrent of debate about privacy.
words.example3Translation: Film shaxsiy hayot haqida kuchli bahslar to'lqinini qo'zg'atdi.

words.translation: ... ning beshigi bo'lmoq, rivojlanishiga sharoit yaratmoq
words.definition: To provide the conditions in which something new can develop. (IELTS ≈ nurture · foster · be a breeding ground for · cultivate)
words.definitionUz: act as an incubator for — yangi narsa rivojlanishi mumkin bo'lgan sharoitni ta'minlamoq.
words.example1: Universities often act as an incubator for new businesses.
words.example1Translation: Universitetlar ko'pincha yangi bizneslar uchun beshik vazifasini bajaradi.
words.example2: Many start-ups first develop inside universities.
words.example2Translation: Ko'plab startaplar dastlab universitetlar ichida rivojlanadi.
words.example3: Coffee houses acted as an incubator for political ideas.
words.example3Translation: Qahvaxonalar siyosiy g'oyalarning beshigi bo'lgan.

words.definition: An indirect result of something that causes further effects. (IELTS ≈ a ripple effect · a chain reaction · a secondary consequence)
words.definitionUz: a knock-on effect — keyingi oqibatlarga sabab bo'ladigan bilvosita natija.
words.example1: The strike had a knock-on effect on other industries.
words.example1Translation: Ish tashlash boshqa tarmoqlarga zanjirli ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
words.example2: Other businesses also suffered because of the strike.
words.example2Translation: Ish tashlash tufayli boshqa bizneslar ham zarar ko'rdi.
words.example3: Higher fuel costs have a knock-on effect on food prices.
words.example3Translation: Yoqilg'i narxining oshishi oziq-ovqat narxlariga zanjirli ta'sir qiladi.

words.definition: To make a crisis happen suddenly or sooner than expected. (IELTS ≈ trigger a crisis · bring about a crisis · spark an emergency)
words.definitionUz: precipitate a crisis — inqirozning to'satdan yoki kutilganidan oldin yuz berishiga sabab bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The sudden rise in oil prices precipitated a crisis.
words.example1Translation: Neft narxining to'satdan oshishi inqirozni keltirib chiqardi.
words.example2: The crisis began when oil suddenly became much more expensive.
words.example2Translation: Inqiroz neft to'satdan ancha qimmatlashganda boshlandi.
words.example3: A single mistake could precipitate a crisis.
words.example3Translation: Birgina xato inqirozni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

words.definition: The complex and often unexpected results of an action. (IELTS ≈ consequences · implications · repercussions · effects)
words.definitionUz: ramifications — harakatning murakkab va ko'pincha kutilmagan natijalari.
words.example1: Few people understood the ramifications of the new law.
words.example1Translation: Kam odam yangi qonunning oqibatlarini tushundi.
words.example2: Most people did not realise how much the law would change.
words.example2Translation: Ko'pchilik qonun qanchalik ko'p narsani o'zgartirishini anglamadi.
words.example3: The decision has serious ramifications for the economy.
words.example3Translation: Qaror iqtisodiyot uchun jiddiy oqibatlarga ega.

words.definition: Unintended bad effects of an event or action. (IELTS ≈ consequences · after-effects · fallout · backlash)
words.definitionUz: repercussions — voqea yoki harakatning ko'zda tutilmagan yomon ta'sirlari.
words.example1: The scandal had repercussions for the whole government.
words.example1Translation: Janjal butun hukumat uchun salbiy oqibatlarga olib keldi.
words.example2: The whole government suffered because of the scandal.
words.example2Translation: Janjal tufayli butun hukumat zarar ko'rdi.
words.example3: Workers feared repercussions if they complained.
words.example3Translation: Ishchilar shikoyat qilsa, salbiy oqibatlar bo'lishidan qo'rqishdi.

words.definition: To cause a feeling or situation to exist. (IELTS ≈ cause · produce · create · give rise to)
words.definitionUz: engender — his yoki vaziyatning yuzaga kelishiga sabab bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The policy engendered distrust among local people.
words.example1Translation: Siyosat mahalliy aholi orasida ishonchsizlik tug'dirdi.
words.example2: Local people stopped trusting the authorities because of the policy.
words.example2Translation: Siyosat tufayli mahalliy aholi hokimiyatga ishonmay qo'ydi.
words.example3: Good teachers engender a love of learning.
words.example3Translation: Yaxshi o'qituvchilar ilmga muhabbat uyg'otadi.

words.definition: To cause something, especially a physical effect. (IELTS ≈ cause · bring on · produce · trigger)
words.definitionUz: induce — biror narsaga, ayniqsa jismoniy ta'sirga, sabab bo'lmoq.
words.example1: Some medicines can induce drowsiness.
words.example1Translation: Ba'zi dorilar uyquchanlikni qo'zg'atishi mumkin.
words.example2: Certain drugs may make you feel sleepy.
words.example2Translation: Ayrim dorilar sizni uyquchan qilishi mumkin.
words.example3: Nothing could induce him to change his mind.
words.example3Translation: Hech narsa uni fikrini o'zgartirishga undamas edi.

words.definition: A person or thing from which something later develops. (IELTS ≈ forerunner · ancestor · originator · precursor)
words.definitionUz: progenitor — keyinchalik biror narsa rivojlangan shaxs yoki narsa.
words.example1: The wolf is the progenitor of the domestic dog.
words.example1Translation: Bo'ri uy itining ajdodidir.
words.example2: Pet dogs are descended from wolves.
words.example2Translation: Uy itlari bo'rilardan kelib chiqqan.
words.example3: He is seen as the progenitor of modern jazz.
words.example3Translation: U zamonaviy jazning asoschisi sifatida qaraladi.

words.definition: Something that encourages a process to happen faster. (IELTS ≈ stimulus · driving force · momentum · incentive)
words.definitionUz: impetus — jarayonning tezroq yuz berishiga undaydigan narsa.
words.example1: The disaster gave new impetus to safety reform.
words.example1Translation: Falokat xavfsizlik islohotiga yangi turtki berdi.
words.example2: After the disaster, efforts to improve safety sped up.
words.example2Translation: Falokatdan keyin xavfsizlikni yaxshilash harakatlari tezlashdi.
words.example3: Cheaper solar panels provided the impetus for change.
words.example3Translation: Arzonroq quyosh panellari o'zgarishga turtki bo'ldi.

words.definition: Several causes coming together to produce a result. (IELTS ≈ a combination of causes · several factors together)
words.definitionUz: a confluence of factors — bir natijani keltirib chiqargan bir necha sababning birlashuvi.
words.example1: The empire fell because of a confluence of factors.
words.example1Translation: Imperiya omillar uyg'unligi tufayli quladi.
words.example2: Many different causes together led to the empire's collapse.
words.example2Translation: Ko'plab turli sabablar birgalikda imperiyaning qulashiga olib keldi.
words.example3: A confluence of factors made the harvest unusually poor.
words.example3Translation: Omillar uyg'unligi hosilni g'ayrioddiy darajada kam qildi.

words.definition: To be a sign of a wider problem. (IELTS ≈ be a sign of · indicate · reflect · point to)
words.definitionUz: be symptomatic of — kengroq muammoning belgisi bo'lmoq.
words.example1: Long hospital queues are symptomatic of underfunding.
words.example1Translation: Shifoxonalardagi uzun navbatlar mablag' yetishmasligining belgisidir.
words.example2: Long waits show that hospitals do not have enough money.
words.example2Translation: Uzoq kutish shifoxonalarda pul yetishmasligini ko'rsatadi.
words.example3: His anger was symptomatic of deeper stress.
words.example3Translation: Uning jahli chuqurroq stressning belgisi edi.

words.definition: To be an extra result that happens as a side effect of something else. (IELTS ≈ be a side effect of · result incidentally from · be a spin-off of)
words.definitionUz: be a by-product of — boshqa narsaning yon ta'siri sifatida yuz beradigan qo'shimcha natija bo'lmoq.
words.example1: Heat is a by-product of electricity generation.
words.example1Translation: Issiqlik elektr energiyasi ishlab chiqarishning qo'shimcha mahsulidir.
words.example2: Producing electricity also creates unwanted heat.
words.example2Translation: Elektr ishlab chiqarish keraksiz issiqlikni ham hosil qiladi.
words.example3: Better health was a by-product of the cycling scheme.
words.example3Translation: Sog'liqning yaxshilanishi velosiped dasturining qo'shimcha natijasi bo'ldi.

words.definition: To separate what is proven from what is only guessed. (IELTS ≈ separate truth from speculation · distinguish fact from guesswork)
words.definitionUz: winnow fact from conjecture — isbotlangan narsani faqat taxmin qilingandan ajratmoq.
words.example1: Historians must winnow fact from conjecture in ancient sources.
words.example1Translation: Tarixchilar qadimiy manbalarda faktni taxmindan ajratishlari kerak.
words.example2: Researchers have to decide what in old texts is true and what is guesswork.
words.example2Translation: Tadqiqotchilar eski matnlardagi nima haqiqat va nima taxmin ekanini hal qilishi kerak.
words.example3: Good journalists winnow fact from conjecture.
words.example3Translation: Yaxshi jurnalistlar faktni taxmindan ajratadi.

words.definition: To be a clear test that shows the true nature of something. (IELTS ≈ be a decisive test of · serve as an indicator of · be a touchstone for)
words.definitionUz: be a litmus test for — biror narsaning haqiqiy mohiyatini ko'rsatadigan aniq sinov bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The election will be a litmus test for the new government.
words.example1Translation: Saylov yangi hukumat uchun hal qiluvchi sinov bo'ladi.
words.example2: The vote will show clearly how popular the government is.
words.example2Translation: Ovoz berish hukumat qanchalik mashhur ekanini aniq ko'rsatadi.
words.example3: Climate policy is a litmus test for political leadership.
words.example3Translation: Iqlim siyosati siyosiy yetakchilik uchun hal qiluvchi sinovdir.

words.definition: Evidence so strong that nobody can doubt it. (IELTS ≈ undeniable evidence · conclusive proof · irrefutable evidence)
words.definitionUz: incontrovertible proof — hech kim shubha qila olmaydigan darajada kuchli dalil.
words.example1: DNA tests provided incontrovertible proof of his innocence.
words.example1Translation: DNK tahlillari uning aybsizligiga rad etib bo'lmaydigan dalil bo'ldi.
words.example2: Genetic evidence showed beyond any doubt that he was innocent.
words.example2Translation: Genetik dalillar uning aybsiz ekanini hech qanday shubhasiz ko'rsatdi.
words.example3: There is still no incontrovertible proof that the drug works.
words.example3Translation: Dori ishlashiga hali rad etib bo'lmaydigan dalil yo'q.

words.definition: To choose only the information that supports your view and ignore the rest. (IELTS ≈ select data selectively · present one-sided evidence)
words.definitionUz: cherry-pick data — faqat o'z fikringizni quvvatlaydigan ma'lumotni tanlab, qolganini e'tiborsiz qoldirmoq.
words.example1: Critics accused the company of cherry-picking data.
words.example1Translation: Tanqidchilar kompaniyani ma'lumotlarni tanlab olishda aybladi.
words.example2: The firm was said to show only the figures that suited it.
words.example2Translation: Firma faqat o'ziga ma'qul raqamlarni ko'rsatgan deyildi.
words.example3: Honest researchers do not cherry-pick data.
words.example3Translation: Halol tadqiqotchilar ma'lumotlarni tanlab olmaydi.

words.definition: To remain convincing when examined carefully. (IELTS ≈ survive close examination · hold up · withstand analysis)
words.definitionUz: stand up to scrutiny — puxta tekshirilganda ham ishonarliligicha qolmoq.
words.example1: The theory does not stand up to scrutiny.
words.example1Translation: Nazariya sinchkov tekshiruvga bardosh bermaydi.
words.example2: When examined closely, the idea falls apart.
words.example2Translation: Yaqindan tekshirilganda g'oya puchga chiqadi.
words.example3: Her account of events stood up to scrutiny in court.
words.example3Translation: Uning voqealar haqidagi bayoni sudda sinchkov tekshiruvga bardosh berdi.

words.definition: A result that appears only because of how something was measured, not because it is real. (IELTS ≈ a measurement error · a methodological illusion · a false signal)
words.definitionUz: an artefact of measurement — haqiqiy emas, faqat o'lchash usuli tufayli paydo bo'lgan natija.
words.example1: The apparent rise in crime may be an artefact of measurement.
words.example1Translation: Jinoyatchilikning ko'rinadigan o'sishi o'lchash usulidan kelib chiqqan xato bo'lishi mumkin.
words.example2: Crime may only seem higher because it is now recorded differently.
words.example2Translation: Jinoyatchilik endi boshqacha qayd etilgani uchun ko'proq bo'lib ko'rinishi mumkin.
words.example3: Scientists checked that the result was not an artefact of measurement.
words.example3Translation: Olimlar natija o'lchash xatosi emasligini tekshirishdi.

words.definition: To carefully separate the different causes that are mixed together. (IELTS ≈ separate the causes · untangle the factors · disentangle causes)
words.definitionUz: tease apart causal threads — aralashib ketgan turli sabablarni ehtiyotkorlik bilan ajratmoq.
words.example1: Researchers tried to tease apart causal threads linking diet and disease.
words.example1Translation: Tadqiqotchilar ovqatlanish va kasallikni bog'lovchi sabab-oqibat bog'lanishlarini ajratishga harakat qilishdi.
words.example2: Scientists worked out which aspects of diet actually cause illness.
words.example2Translation: Olimlar ovqatlanishning qaysi jihatlari aslida kasallikka sabab bo'lishini aniqlashdi.
words.example3: It is hard to tease apart causal threads in complex systems.
words.example3Translation: Murakkab tizimlarda sabab-oqibat bog'lanishlarini ajratish qiyin.

words.translation: ... ga uzoq vaqt salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatmoq
words.definition: To have a negative effect on something for a long time. (IELTS ≈ have a lasting negative effect on · overshadow · haunt)
words.definitionUz: cast a long shadow over — uzoq vaqt davomida biror narsaga salbiy ta'sir qilmoq.
words.example1: The war cast a long shadow over the country's development.
words.example1Translation: Urush mamlakat taraqqiyotiga uzoq vaqt salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
words.example2: The country's progress was affected by the war for many years.
words.example2Translation: Mamlakat taraqqiyotiga urush ko'p yillar davomida ta'sir qildi.
words.example3: The scandal continues to cast a long shadow over the company.
words.example3Translation: Janjal kompaniyaga uzoq vaqtdan beri salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatmoqda.

words.definition: To gradually gather useful knowledge from something. (IELTS ≈ gather understanding from · learn from · extract knowledge from)
words.definitionUz: glean insights from — biror narsadan asta-sekin foydali bilim yig'moq.
words.example1: Researchers gleaned insights from thousands of patient records.
words.example1Translation: Tadqiqotchilar minglab bemor yozuvlaridan tushunchalar to'plashdi.
words.example2: Scientists learned a great deal by studying many medical files.
words.example2Translation: Olimlar ko'plab tibbiy hujjatlarni o'rganib, ko'p narsa bilib olishdi.
words.example3: We can glean insights from how other countries solved the problem.
words.example3Translation: Boshqa mamlakatlar muammoni qanday hal qilganidan tushunchalar olishimiz mumkin.

words.definition: A connection between two things that seems real but is caused by chance or another factor. (IELTS ≈ a false link · a coincidental connection · a misleading correlation)
words.definitionUz: a spurious correlation — haqiqiy bo'lib ko'rinadigan, lekin tasodif yoki boshqa omil tufayli yuzaga kelgan bog'liqlik.
words.example1: The link between ice cream sales and drownings is a spurious correlation.
words.example1Translation: Muzqaymoq savdosi va cho'kishlar o'rtasidagi bog'liqlik soxta bog'liqlikdir.
words.example2: Both rise in hot weather, but one does not cause the other.
words.example2Translation: Ikkalasi ham issiqda oshadi, lekin biri ikkinchisiga sabab bo'lmaydi.
words.example3: Large data sets often produce spurious correlations.
words.example3Translation: Katta ma'lumotlar to'plamlari ko'pincha soxta bog'liqliklarni yuzaga keltiradi.

words.definition: A large collection of academic writing on a subject. (IELTS ≈ a body of research · academic literature · a collection of studies)
words.definitionUz: a corpus of scholarship — biror mavzu bo'yicha akademik asarlarning katta to'plami.
words.example1: There is a large corpus of scholarship on the Silk Road.
words.example1Translation: Ipak yo'li haqida katta ilmiy asarlar majmuasi bor.
words.example2: Many academics have written about the Silk Road.
words.example2Translation: Ko'plab olimlar Ipak yo'li haqida yozgan.
words.example3: Her work added significantly to the corpus of scholarship.
words.example3Translation: Uning ishi ilmiy asarlar majmuasiga sezilarli hissa qo'shdi.

words.word: beyond a shadow of a doubt
words.definition: With complete certainty. (IELTS ≈ without any doubt · with absolute certainty · conclusively)
words.definitionUz: beyond a shadow of a doubt — to'liq ishonch bilan.
words.example1: The tests proved beyond a shadow of a doubt that the painting was a fake.
words.example1Translation: Tahlillar rasm soxta ekanini hech qanday shubhasiz isbotladi.
words.example2: It is now completely certain that the picture is not genuine.
words.example2Translation: Rasm haqiqiy emasligi endi mutlaqo aniq.
words.example3: We cannot say beyond a shadow of a doubt what caused the fire.
words.example3Translation: Yong'inga nima sabab bo'lganini hech qanday shubhasiz ayta olmaymiz.

words.definition: The principle that a scientific theory must be testable and possible to prove wrong. (IELTS ≈ testability · the principle that theories must be disprovable)
words.definitionUz: the falsifiability criterion — ilmiy nazariya sinovdan o'tkazilishi va noto'g'riligi isbotlanishi mumkin bo'lishi kerak degan tamoyil.
words.example1: Astrology fails the falsifiability criterion.
words.example1Translation: Munajjimlik soxtalashtirish mezoniga javob bermaydi.
words.example2: Astrology cannot be tested in a way that could prove it wrong.
words.example2Translation: Munajjimlikni noto'g'riligini isbotlay oladigan tarzda sinab bo'lmaydi.
words.example3: Popper introduced the falsifiability criterion to define science.
words.example3Translation: Popper fanni ta'riflash uchun soxtalashtirish mezonini kiritgan.

words.translation: ekstrapolyatsiya qilmoq, mavjud ma'lumotdan taxmin qilmoq
words.definition: To use known facts to estimate something unknown, such as future trends. (IELTS ≈ project · predict from data · infer · estimate)
words.definitionUz: extrapolate — ma'lum faktlardan noma'lum narsani, masalan kelajak tendensiyalarini, taxmin qilmoq.
words.example1: It is risky to extrapolate from such a small sample.
words.example1Translation: Bunday kichik tanlanmadan xulosa chiqarish xavfli.
words.example2: You cannot reliably predict much from so few cases.
words.example2Translation: Juda kam holatdan ishonchli bashorat qilib bo'lmaydi.
words.example3: Scientists extrapolated future sea levels from current data.
words.example3Translation: Olimlar hozirgi ma'lumotlardan kelajakdagi dengiz sathini taxmin qilishdi.

words.definition: To suggest a theory as a basis for reasoning. (IELTS ≈ propose · hypothesise · suggest · put forward)
words.definitionUz: postulate — mulohaza uchun asos sifatida nazariyani taklif qilmoq.
words.example1: Scientists postulated the existence of the planet before it was seen.
words.example1Translation: Olimlar sayyora ko'rinishidan oldin uning mavjudligini faraz qilishgan.
words.example2: Researchers suggested the planet existed before anyone observed it.
words.example2Translation: Tadqiqotchilar sayyora hech kim ko'rmasdan oldin mavjud deb taxmin qilishgan.
words.example3: Some experts postulate that the disease began in bats.
words.example3Translation: Ba'zi mutaxassislar kasallik ko'rshapalaklardan boshlangan deb faraz qiladi.

words.definition: To measure or express something as a number. (IELTS ≈ measure · calculate · put a figure on · count)
words.definitionUz: quantify — biror narsani o'lchamoq yoki raqam bilan ifodalamoq.
words.example1: It is difficult to quantify the value of happiness.
words.example1Translation: Baxtning qiymatini miqdoriy o'lchash qiyin.
words.example2: You cannot easily put a number on how happy people are.
words.example2Translation: Odamlar qanchalik baxtli ekanini raqam bilan ifodalash oson emas.
words.example3: The study quantified the damage caused by the flood.
words.example3Translation: Tadqiqot suv toshqini yetkazgan zararni miqdoriy jihatdan o'lchadi.

words.definition: A quick look that is not careful or thorough. (IELTS ≈ a quick look · a superficial check · a brief inspection)
words.definitionUz: a cursory examination — puxta bo'lmagan tez qarash.
words.example1: Even a cursory examination of the data reveals errors.
words.example1Translation: Hatto ma'lumotlarni yuzaki ko'zdan kechirish ham xatolarni ochib beradi.
words.example2: A quick look at the figures shows they contain mistakes.
words.example2Translation: Raqamlarga qisqa nazar tashlash ularda xatolar borligini ko'rsatadi.
words.example3: The doctor gave the patient only a cursory examination.
words.example3Translation: Shifokor bemorni faqat yuzaki ko'rikdan o'tkazdi.

words.definition: To be able to be understood in different ways. (IELTS ≈ be ambiguous · be debatable · have more than one meaning)
words.definitionUz: be open to interpretation — turli xil tushunilishi mumkin bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The results of the survey are open to interpretation.
words.example1Translation: So'rovnoma natijalari turlicha talqin qilinishi mumkin.
words.example2: People can read the survey findings in different ways.
words.example2Translation: Odamlar so'rovnoma natijalarini turlicha tushunishlari mumkin.
words.example3: The meaning of the poem is open to interpretation.
words.example3Translation: She'rning ma'nosi turlicha talqin qilinishi mumkin.

words.definition: Evidence based on personal stories rather than careful research. (IELTS ≈ personal accounts · unscientific evidence · hearsay)
words.definitionUz: anecdotal evidence — puxta tadqiqot emas, shaxsiy hikoyalarga asoslangan dalil.
words.example1: There is only anecdotal evidence that the herb cures colds.
words.example1Translation: O'tning shamollashni davolashi haqida faqat tasodifiy hikoyalarga asoslangan dalillar bor.
words.example2: The claim is based on people's stories, not on scientific tests.
words.example2Translation: Bu da'vo ilmiy sinovlarga emas, odamlarning hikoyalariga asoslangan.
words.example3: Anecdotal evidence suggests that the new rules are working.
words.example3Translation: Tasodifiy hikoyalarga ko'ra, yangi qoidalar ish bermoqda.

words.definition: To be completely opposite to something. (IELTS ≈ be completely opposite to · be totally contrary to · be at the opposite extreme from)
words.definitionUz: be diametrically opposed to — biror narsaga butunlay qarama-qarshi bo'lmoq.
words.example1: Their views on education are diametrically opposed.
words.example1Translation: Ularning ta'lim haqidagi qarashlari mutlaqo qarama-qarshi.
words.example2: The two of them think in completely opposite ways about schooling.
words.example2Translation: Ikkalasi ta'lim haqida butunlay qarama-qarshi fikrlaydi.
words.example3: The new policy is diametrically opposed to the old one.
words.example3Translation: Yangi siyosat eskisiga mutlaqo qarama-qarshi.

words.definition: To go against what seems sensible or what evidence suggests. (IELTS ≈ contradict · defy · go against · run counter to)
words.definitionUz: fly in the face of — oqilona yoki dalillar ko'rsatgan narsaga zid kelmoq.
words.example1: The decision flies in the face of scientific advice.
words.example1Translation: Bu qaror ilmiy maslahatga butunlay zid.
words.example2: The choice ignores what scientists recommended.
words.example2Translation: Bu tanlov olimlar tavsiya qilgan narsani e'tiborsiz qoldiradi.
words.example3: His claims fly in the face of all the evidence.
words.example3Translation: Uning da'volari barcha dalillarga butunlay zid.

words.definition: Apparently or seemingly, but perhaps not really. (IELTS ≈ apparently · seemingly · supposedly · on the surface)
words.definitionUz: ostensibly — zohiran, lekin ehtimol aslida unday emas.
words.example1: The tax was ostensibly introduced to protect the environment.
words.example1Translation: Soliq go'yoki atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish uchun joriy etilgan.
words.example2: The official reason for the tax was nature, but there may have been others.
words.example2Translation: Soliqning rasmiy sababi tabiat edi, lekin boshqa sabablar ham bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin.
words.example3: He was ostensibly on holiday but was actually working.
words.example3Translation: U go'yoki ta'tilda edi, lekin aslida ishlayotgan edi.

words.definition: A difference in wording that has no real practical effect. (IELTS ≈ a meaningless distinction · a difference in name only)
words.definitionUz: a distinction without a difference — amalda hech qanday ta'siri yo'q so'zdagi farq.
words.example1: Calling it a fee instead of a tax is a distinction without a difference.
words.example1Translation: Uni soliq o'rniga yig'im deb atash amalda farqi yo'q ajratishdir.
words.example2: Whatever it is called, people still have to pay the same money.
words.example2Translation: Qanday atalmasin, odamlar baribir bir xil pul to'lashlari kerak.
words.example3: Critics said the change was a distinction without a difference.
words.example3Translation: Tanqidchilar o'zgarish amalda hech narsani o'zgartirmaydi deyishdi.

words.definition: To be in strong disagreement about something. (IELTS ≈ disagree strongly about · clash over · be in dispute over)
words.definitionUz: be at loggerheads over — biror narsa bo'yicha qattiq kelishmaslik.
words.example1: The two countries are at loggerheads over fishing rights.
words.example1Translation: Ikki mamlakat baliq ovlash huquqlari bo'yicha qattiq kelishmovchilikda.
words.example2: The nations strongly disagree about who can fish in the area.
words.example2Translation: Davlatlar hududda kim baliq ovlashi mumkinligi borasida qattiq kelishmaydi.
words.example3: Unions and management are at loggerheads over pay.
words.example3Translation: Kasaba uyushmalari va rahbariyat ish haqi bo'yicha qattiq kelishmovchilikda.

words.definition: The exact opposite of something. (IELTS ≈ the opposite of · the reverse of · the contrary of)
words.definitionUz: the antithesis of — biror narsaning aynan aksi.
words.example1: His calm style is the antithesis of his predecessor's.
words.example1Translation: Uning xotirjam uslubi o'tmishdoshining uslubiga mutlaqo aksdir.
words.example2: He behaves in the opposite way to the person before him.
words.example2Translation: U o'zidan oldingi kishiga mutlaqo teskari tarzda o'zini tutadi.
words.example3: Mass tourism is the antithesis of sustainable travel.
words.example3Translation: Ommaviy turizm barqaror sayohatning mutlaq aksidir.

words.definition: To belong partly to two different groups or ways of life. (IELTS ≈ live between two cultures · belong to both sides)
words.definitionUz: straddle two worlds — qisman ikki xil guruh yoki turmush tarziga mansub bo'lmoq.
words.example1: Children of immigrants often straddle two worlds.
words.example1Translation: Muhojirlarning farzandlari ko'pincha ikki dunyo o'rtasida yashaydi.
words.example2: These children belong to both their parents' culture and the new one.
words.example2Translation: Bu bolalar ham ota-onasining, ham yangi madaniyatga mansub.
words.example3: The museum straddles two worlds, art and science.
words.example3Translation: Muzey ikki dunyo — san'at va fan o'rtasida turadi.

words.definition: As a warning or condition to consider. (IELTS ≈ as a warning · with a reservation · as a qualification)
words.definitionUz: by way of caveat — e'tiborga olinadigan ogohlantirish yoki shart sifatida.
words.example1: By way of caveat, the authors note that the sample was small.
words.example1Translation: Ogohlantirish sifatida mualliflar tanlanma kichik bo'lganini qayd etishadi.
words.example2: The writers warn readers that few people were studied.
words.example2Translation: Mualliflar o'quvchilarni kam odam o'rganilgani haqida ogohlantiradi.
words.example3: By way of caveat, these figures are only estimates.
words.example3Translation: Ogohlantirish sifatida aytish kerakki, bu raqamlar faqat taxmin.

words.definition: To be different from what something looks like. (IELTS ≈ contradict its look · be deceptive · disguise its true nature)
words.definitionUz: belie its appearance — biror narsaning tashqi ko'rinishidan farqli bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The simple house belies its appearance; inside it is full of technology.
words.example1Translation: Oddiy uy tashqi ko'rinishiga zid; ichi texnologiyaga to'la.
words.example2: The house looks plain, but it is actually very high-tech.
words.example2Translation: Uy oddiy ko'rinadi, lekin aslida juda zamonaviy.
words.example3: The tiny insect's strength belies its appearance.
words.example3Translation: Mitti hasharotning kuchi uning tashqi ko'rinishiga zid.

words.definition: To hide problems instead of solving them. (IELTS ≈ cover up problems · disguise difficulties · apply a quick fix)
words.definitionUz: paper over the cracks — muammolarni hal qilish o'rniga ularni yashirmoq.
words.example1: The new funding merely papers over the cracks in the system.
words.example1Translation: Yangi mablag' tizimdagi muammolarni shunchaki yuzaki yashiradi.
words.example2: The money hides the problems but does not fix them.
words.example2Translation: Pul muammolarni yashiradi, lekin ularni hal qilmaydi.
words.example3: You cannot paper over the cracks in a relationship forever.
words.example3Translation: Munosabatlardagi muammolarni abadiy yashirib bo'lmaydi.

words.definition: To have both good and bad effects. (IELTS ≈ have advantages and disadvantages · work for and against)
words.definitionUz: cut both ways — ham yaxshi, ham yomon ta'sirga ega bo'lmoq.
words.example1: Being well known cuts both ways.
words.example1Translation: Mashhur bo'lish ikki tomonlama ta'sir qiladi.
words.example2: Fame brings benefits but also problems.
words.example2Translation: Shuhrat foyda bilan birga muammolar ham olib keladi.
words.example3: A weak currency cuts both ways for an economy.
words.example3Translation: Zaif valyuta iqtisodiyotga ikki tomonlama ta'sir qiladi.

words.definition: To try to bring together things that cannot fit together. (IELTS ≈ unite opposites · combine incompatible aims)
words.definitionUz: reconcile the irreconcilable — bir-biriga mos kelmaydigan narsalarni birlashtirishga harakat qilmoq.
words.example1: The government is trying to reconcile the irreconcilable: lower taxes and better services.
words.example1Translation: Hukumat murosaga kelmaydigan narsalarni — past soliqlar va yaxshiroq xizmatlarni — murosaga keltirishga harakat qilmoqda.
words.example2: It is very hard to cut taxes and also improve public services.
words.example2Translation: Soliqlarni kamaytirib, ayni paytda davlat xizmatlarini yaxshilash juda qiyin.
words.example3: Diplomats were asked to reconcile the irreconcilable.
words.example3Translation: Diplomatlardan murosaga kelmaydigan narsalarni murosaga keltirish so'raldi.

words.definition: To show that something is not true. (IELTS ≈ disprove · contradict · expose as false · refute)
words.definitionUz: give the lie to — biror narsa to'g'ri emasligini ko'rsatmoq.
words.example1: Her success gives the lie to the idea that women cannot be engineers.
words.example1Translation: Uning muvaffaqiyati ayollar muhandis bo'la olmaydi degan g'oyaning yolg'onligini ko'rsatadi.
words.example2: She proves that women can certainly become engineers.
words.example2Translation: U ayollar muhandis bo'la olishini aniq isbotlaydi.
words.example3: The figures give the lie to the minister's claims.
words.example3Translation: Raqamlar vazirning da'volarining yolg'onligini ko'rsatadi.

words.definition: An appearance of agreement that hides real disagreement. (IELTS ≈ a false appearance of agreement · superficial unity)
words.definitionUz: a veneer of consensus — haqiqiy kelishmovchilikni yashiradigan kelishuv ko'rinishi.
words.example1: Behind a veneer of consensus, the party was deeply divided.
words.example1Translation: Zohiriy hamfikrlik ortida partiya chuqur bo'lingan edi.
words.example2: The party looked united but its members strongly disagreed.
words.example2Translation: Partiya birlashgan ko'rinardi, lekin a'zolari qattiq kelishmasdi.
words.example3: The summit produced only a veneer of consensus.
words.example3Translation: Sammit faqat zohiriy hamfikrlikka olib keldi.

words.word: err on the side of caution
words.definition: To choose the safer option when unsure. (IELTS ≈ be extra careful · play it safe · take no chances)
words.definitionUz: err on the side of caution — ishonchsiz bo'lganda xavfsizroq yo'lni tanlamoq.
words.example1: Doctors tend to err on the side of caution with young patients.
words.example1Translation: Shifokorlar yosh bemorlar bilan ishlaganda ehtiyotkorlikni tanlashga moyil.
words.example2: With children, doctors usually choose the safest option.
words.example2Translation: Bolalar bilan shifokorlar odatda eng xavfsiz yo'lni tanlaydi.
words.example3: When in doubt, it is wise to err on the side of caution.
words.example3Translation: Shubha bo'lganda ehtiyotkorlikni tanlash oqilona.

words.definition: To be clearly different from something else, making the difference very obvious. (IELTS ≈ contrast sharply with · stand out clearly against)
words.definitionUz: stand in stark relief against — boshqa narsadan aniq farq qilib, farqni juda yaqqol ko'rsatmoq.
words.example1: The city's wealth stands in stark relief against the poverty of the villages.
words.example1Translation: Shaharning boyligi qishloqlarning qashshoqligi fonida yaqqol ajralib turadi.
words.example2: The rich city contrasts sharply with the poor countryside.
words.example2Translation: Boy shahar kambag'al qishloq bilan keskin farq qiladi.
words.example3: Her honesty stands in stark relief against his lies.
words.example3Translation: Uning halolligi uning yolg'onlari fonida yaqqol ajralib turadi.

words.definition: Despite how things may seem. (IELTS ≈ despite how it looks · although it may not seem so)
words.definitionUz: notwithstanding appearances to the contrary — narsalar qanday ko'rinishidan qat'i nazar.
words.example1: Notwithstanding appearances to the contrary, the company is in financial trouble.
words.example1Translation: Aksini ko'rsatuvchi belgilarga qaramay, kompaniya moliyaviy qiyinchilikda.
words.example2: The firm looks successful, but it actually has money problems.
words.example2Translation: Firma muvaffaqiyatli ko'rinadi, lekin aslida pul muammolari bor.
words.example3: Notwithstanding appearances to the contrary, the two leaders get on well.
words.example3Translation: Aksini ko'rsatuvchi belgilarga qaramay, ikki rahbar yaxshi munosabatda.

words.definition: A division between two completely opposite things. (IELTS ≈ division · contrast · split · polarity)
words.definitionUz: dichotomy — ikki butunlay qarama-qarshi narsa o'rtasidagi bo'linish.
words.example1: The book challenges the dichotomy between nature and nurture.
words.example1Translation: Kitob tabiat va tarbiya o'rtasidagi keskin bo'linishni shubha ostiga qo'yadi.
words.example2: The author argues that genes and upbringing are not simply opposites.
words.example2Translation: Muallif genlar va tarbiya shunchaki qarama-qarshilik emasligini ta'kidlaydi.
words.example3: There is a false dichotomy between growth and the environment.
words.example3Translation: O'sish va atrof-muhit o'rtasida soxta qarama-qarshilik bor.

words.definition: To place two things side by side, especially to show a contrast. (IELTS ≈ place side by side · contrast · set against each other)
words.definitionUz: juxtapose — ikki narsani, ayniqsa farqni ko'rsatish uchun, yonma-yon qo'ymoq.
words.example1: The exhibition juxtaposes ancient and modern art.
words.example1Translation: Ko'rgazma qadimiy va zamonaviy san'atni yonma-yon qo'yadi.
words.example2: Old and new artworks are displayed next to each other.
words.example2Translation: Eski va yangi san'at asarlari yonma-yon namoyish etiladi.
words.example3: The film juxtaposes scenes of wealth and poverty.
words.example3Translation: Film boylik va qashshoqlik sahnalarini yonma-yon qo'yadi.

words.definition: Directly opposed to something. (IELTS ≈ opposed · contrary · incompatible · contradictory)
words.definitionUz: antithetical — biror narsaga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qarshi.
words.example1: Censorship is antithetical to democracy.
words.example1Translation: Senzura demokratiyaga mutlaqo zid.
words.example2: Controlling the press goes completely against democratic values.
words.example2Translation: Matbuotni nazorat qilish demokratik qadriyatlarga butunlay zid.
words.example3: These goals are antithetical to each other.
words.example3Translation: Bu maqsadlar bir-biriga mutlaqo zid.

words.definition: Strange because it does not fit with its surroundings. (IELTS ≈ out of place · inappropriate · discordant · odd)
words.definitionUz: incongruous — atrofga mos kelmagani uchun g'alati.
words.example1: The modern glass tower looks incongruous in the old town.
words.example1Translation: Zamonaviy shisha minora eski shaharda o'rinsiz ko'rinadi.
words.example2: The new building does not suit the historic streets around it.
words.example2Translation: Yangi bino atrofdagi tarixiy ko'chalarga mos emas.
words.example3: His cheerful tone seemed incongruous at the funeral.
words.example3Translation: Uning quvnoq ohangi dafn marosimida o'rinsiz tuyuldi.

words.definition: Opposite in effect or order. (IELTS ≈ opposite · reverse · contrary · inverted)
words.definitionUz: inverse — ta'siri yoki tartibi bo'yicha qarama-qarshi.
words.example1: There is an inverse relationship between price and demand.
words.example1Translation: Narx va talab o'rtasida teskari bog'liqlik bor.
words.example2: When prices go up, demand goes down.
words.example2Translation: Narxlar oshganda talab kamayadi.
words.example3: The results were the inverse of what we expected.
words.example3Translation: Natijalar biz kutganning teskarisi bo'ldi.

words.definition: To be different from or in disagreement with something. (IELTS ≈ conflict with · be inconsistent with · contradict · differ from)
words.definitionUz: be at variance with — biror narsadan farq qilmoq yoki unga zid bo'lmoq.
words.example1: His account is at variance with the official version.
words.example1Translation: Uning bayoni rasmiy versiyaga mos kelmaydi.
words.example2: What he says does not match what officials report.
words.example2Translation: Uning aytganlari rasmiylar xabariga mos kelmaydi.
words.example3: These results are at variance with earlier studies.
words.example3Translation: Bu natijalar avvalgi tadqiqotlarga zid.

words.definition: To be the opposite of something. (IELTS ≈ go against · contradict · oppose · conflict with)
words.definitionUz: run counter to — biror narsaning aksi bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The findings run counter to popular belief.
words.example1Translation: Natijalar keng tarqalgan e'tiqodga zid keladi.
words.example2: The results show the opposite of what most people think.
words.example2Translation: Natijalar ko'pchilik o'ylaganining aksini ko'rsatadi.
words.example3: The policy runs counter to the government's own promises.
words.example3Translation: Siyosat hukumatning o'z va'dalariga zid.

words.definition: Just beginning to develop. (IELTS ≈ emerging · budding · developing · fledgling)
words.definitionUz: nascent — endigina rivojlana boshlagan.
words.example1: The country's nascent tech industry is attracting investors.
words.example1Translation: Mamlakatning endigina paydo bo'layotgan texnologiya sanoati investorlarni jalb qilmoqda.
words.example2: The new technology sector is beginning to draw foreign money.
words.example2Translation: Yangi texnologiya sohasi chet el pulini jalb qila boshlamoqda.
words.example3: Nascent democracies are often fragile.
words.example3Translation: Endigina shakllanayotgan demokratiyalar ko'pincha mo'rt bo'ladi.

words.definition: A very large and important change. (IELTS ≈ a radical change · a dramatic transformation · a sea change)
words.definitionUz: a seismic shift — juda katta va muhim o'zgarish.
words.example1: The internet caused a seismic shift in the music industry.
words.example1Translation: Internet musiqa sanoatida tub burilishga sabab bo'ldi.
words.example2: Online streaming completely changed how music is sold.
words.example2Translation: Onlayn tinglash musiqa sotilish usulini butunlay o'zgartirdi.
words.example3: There has been a seismic shift in public attitudes to smoking.
words.example3Translation: Jamoatchilikning chekishga munosabatida tub burilish yuz berdi.

words.definition: To grow quickly from a small problem into a serious one. (IELTS ≈ escalate into a crisis · spiral into an emergency)
words.definitionUz: snowball into a crisis — kichik muammodan tezda jiddiy muammoga aylanmoq.
words.example1: A small dispute snowballed into a national crisis.
words.example1Translation: Kichik nizo kattalashib, milliy inqirozga aylandi.
words.example2: What began as a minor disagreement became a serious national problem.
words.example2Translation: Kichik kelishmovchilik sifatida boshlangan narsa jiddiy milliy muammoga aylandi.
words.example3: Unpaid debts can quickly snowball into a crisis.
words.example3Translation: To'lanmagan qarzlar tezda kattalashib, inqirozga aylanishi mumkin.

words.definition: To be in the middle of a difficult or unpleasant period. (IELTS ≈ be in the midst of · be struggling with · be going through)
words.definitionUz: be in the throes of — qiyin yoki yoqimsiz davrning o'rtasida bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The country is in the throes of an economic crisis.
words.example1Translation: Mamlakat iqtisodiy inqirozning qoq o'rtasida.
words.example2: The nation is currently going through a severe economic slump.
words.example2Translation: Mamlakat hozir og'ir iqtisodiy tanazzulni boshdan kechirmoqda.
words.example3: The industry is in the throes of major change.
words.example3Translation: Soha katta o'zgarishlarning qoq o'rtasida.

words.definition: To become a fixed belief that people no longer question. (IELTS ≈ harden into doctrine · become rigid · become unquestioned belief)
words.definitionUz: ossify into dogma — odamlar endi shubha qilmaydigan qat'iy e'tiqodga aylanmoq.
words.example1: Useful ideas can ossify into dogma if they are never questioned.
words.example1Translation: Foydali g'oyalar hech qachon shubha ostiga olinmasa, qotib qolgan aqidaga aylanishi mumkin.
words.example2: Theories become rigid when nobody challenges them.
words.example2Translation: Hech kim e'tiroz bildirmasa, nazariyalar qotib qoladi.
words.example3: The school's methods had ossified into dogma.
words.example3Translation: Maktab usullari qotib qolgan aqidaga aylangan edi.

words.definition: A very fast rise to success or fame. (IELTS ≈ a rapid ascent · a swift rise · a sudden success)
words.definitionUz: a meteoric rise — muvaffaqiyat yoki shuhratga juda tez ko'tarilish.
words.example1: The singer enjoyed a meteoric rise to fame.
words.example1Translation: Qo'shiqchi shuhratga keskin yuksaldi.
words.example2: The singer became famous extremely quickly.
words.example2Translation: Qo'shiqchi juda tez mashhur bo'ldi.
words.example3: The company's meteoric rise surprised analysts.
words.example3Translation: Kompaniyaning keskin yuksalishi tahlilchilarni hayratda qoldirdi.

words.definition: To be a sign that something is coming to an end. (IELTS ≈ signal the end of · mark the decline of · foreshadow the death of)
words.definitionUz: herald the demise of — biror narsa nihoyasiga yetayotganining belgisi bo'lmoq.
words.example1: E-books were expected to herald the demise of printed books.
words.example1Translation: Elektron kitoblar bosma kitoblarning yo'qolishidan darak beradi deb kutilgan.
words.example2: Many people thought digital reading would end paper books.
words.example2Translation: Ko'pchilik raqamli o'qish qog'oz kitoblarga barham beradi deb o'ylagan.
words.example3: The new law may herald the demise of small farms.
words.example3Translation: Yangi qonun kichik fermalarning yo'qolishidan darak berishi mumkin.

words.definition: To change from vague feelings into an organised campaign. (IELTS ≈ take shape as a campaign · develop into an organised group)
words.definitionUz: crystallise into a movement — noaniq his-tuyg'ulardan uyushgan kampaniyaga aylanmoq.
words.example1: Public anger crystallised into a movement for change.
words.example1Translation: Jamoatchilik g'azabi o'zgarishlar uchun harakatga aylandi.
words.example2: People's frustration developed into an organised campaign.
words.example2Translation: Odamlarning noroziligi uyushgan kampaniyaga aylandi.
words.example3: Scattered protests slowly crystallised into a national movement.
words.example3Translation: Tarqoq noroziliklar asta-sekin milliy harakatga aylandi.

words.definition: To stop a fall that seemed impossible to stop. (IELTS ≈ halt a relentless fall · stop an unstoppable slide)
words.definitionUz: arrest an inexorable decline — to'xtatib bo'lmaydigandek ko'ringan tushishni to'xtatmoq.
words.example1: The new manager managed to arrest the club's inexorable decline.
words.example1Translation: Yangi menejer klubning to'xtatib bo'lmaydigan tanazzulini to'xtatishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
words.example2: The club had been getting worse and worse until he arrived.
words.example2Translation: U kelguncha klub tobora yomonlashib borayotgan edi.
words.example3: Conservationists hope to arrest the inexorable decline of the species.
words.example3Translation: Tabiatni muhofaza qiluvchilar bu turning to'xtatib bo'lmaydigan kamayishini to'xtatishga umid qilmoqda.

words.definition: A sudden success that does not last. (IELTS ≈ a one-off success · a short-lived triumph · a passing fad)
words.definitionUz: a flash in the pan — uzoq davom etmaydigan to'satdan muvaffaqiyat.
words.example1: Critics thought the band would be a flash in the pan.
words.example1Translation: Tanqidchilar guruh bir martalik muvaffaqiyat bo'ladi deb o'ylashgan.
words.example2: Many expected the band's success to be brief.
words.example2Translation: Ko'pchilik guruhning muvaffaqiyati qisqa bo'ladi deb kutgan.
words.example3: The new diet proved to be a flash in the pan.
words.example3Translation: Yangi parhez bir martalik qiziqish bo'lib chiqdi.

words.definition: To be a sign that a new period of revival is coming. (IELTS ≈ signal a revival · foreshadow a rebirth · herald a comeback)
words.definitionUz: presage a renaissance — qayta tiklanishning yangi davri kelayotganining belgisi bo'lmoq.
words.example1: New investment may presage a renaissance for the old port.
words.example1Translation: Yangi sarmoya eski port uchun qayta tug'ilishdan darak berishi mumkin.
words.example2: Fresh funding suggests the harbour could become busy again.
words.example2Translation: Yangi mablag' port yana gavjum bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rsatadi.
words.example3: The success of young writers may presage a renaissance in poetry.
words.example3Translation: Yosh yozuvchilarning muvaffaqiyati she'riyatdagi qayta tug'ilishdan darak berishi mumkin.

words.definition: A path of change that is out of control. (IELTS ≈ an uncontrolled rise · an unstoppable path)
words.definitionUz: a runaway trajectory — nazoratdan chiqqan o'zgarish yo'li.
words.example1: Warming could enter a runaway trajectory if forests die.
words.example1Translation: O'rmonlar nobud bo'lsa, isish nazoratsiz yo'nalishga o'tishi mumkin.
words.example2: If trees disappear, temperatures could rise out of control.
words.example2Translation: Daraxtlar yo'qolsa, harorat nazoratsiz ko'tarilishi mumkin.
words.example3: House prices are on a runaway trajectory.
words.example3Translation: Uy narxlari nazoratsiz o'sish yo'nalishida.

words.definition: To reach a moment when a trend changes direction. (IELTS ≈ reach a turning point · arrive at a moment of change)
words.definitionUz: reach an inflection point — tendensiya yo'nalishini o'zgartiradigan paytga yetmoq.
words.example1: Electric car sales have reached an inflection point.
words.example1Translation: Elektromobillar savdosi burilish nuqtasiga yetdi.
words.example2: Sales of electric cars are now starting to grow very fast.
words.example2Translation: Elektromobillar savdosi endi juda tez o'sa boshlamoqda.
words.example3: The company reached an inflection point after its tenth year.
words.example3Translation: Kompaniya o'ninchi yilidan keyin burilish nuqtasiga yetdi.

words.definition: To gradually become smaller and then end. (IELTS ≈ fade away · dwindle · fizzle out · die out)
words.definitionUz: peter out — asta-sekin kichrayib, keyin tugamoq.
words.example1: The protests petered out after a few weeks.
words.example1Translation: Noroziliklar bir necha haftadan keyin asta-sekin so'nib qoldi.
words.example2: Fewer and fewer people joined the protests until they stopped.
words.example2Translation: Noroziliklarga qo'shiladiganlar tobora kamayib, oxiri to'xtadi.
words.example3: The path petered out in the forest.
words.example3Translation: Yo'lak o'rmonda asta-sekin yo'qolib ketdi.

words.definition: A change from one extreme to the opposite. (IELTS ≈ a reversal · a swing back · a shift to the other extreme)
words.definitionUz: a pendulum swing — bir chekkadan qarama-qarshisiga o'zgarish.
words.example1: Education policy has seen a pendulum swing between strict and relaxed methods.
words.example1Translation: Ta'lim siyosatida qat'iy va erkin usullar o'rtasida mayatnik kabi tebranish kuzatildi.
words.example2: Schools keep moving from strict teaching to relaxed teaching and back.
words.example2Translation: Maktablar qat'iy o'qitishdan erkin o'qitishga va aksincha o'tib turadi.
words.example3: Fashion often follows a pendulum swing.
words.example3Translation: Moda ko'pincha mayatnik kabi tebranishga amal qiladi.

words.definition: To become gradually smaller in size or number. (IELTS ≈ decrease · shrink · diminish · decline)
words.definitionUz: dwindle — hajmi yoki soni asta-sekin kichraymoq.
words.example1: The village population has dwindled to a few hundred.
words.example1Translation: Qishloq aholisi bir necha yuz kishigacha kamayib ketdi.
words.example2: Only a few hundred people now live in the village.
words.example2Translation: Qishloqda endi bor-yo'g'i bir necha yuz kishi yashaydi.
words.example3: Their savings dwindled during the crisis.
words.example3Translation: Inqiroz davrida ularning jamg'armasi kamayib bordi.

words.definition: To become gradually weaker or less important. (IELTS ≈ fade · decline · diminish · weaken)
words.definitionUz: wane — asta-sekin zaiflashmoq yoki ahamiyati kamaymoq.
words.example1: Interest in the story began to wane after a week.
words.example1Translation: Bir haftadan keyin hikoyaga qiziqish so'na boshladi.
words.example2: People became less interested in the news after a few days.
words.example2Translation: Bir necha kundan keyin odamlar yangilikka kamroq qiziqa boshladi.
words.example3: The empire's power waned in the fifteenth century.
words.example3Translation: Imperiya qudrati XV asrda susaydi.

words.definition: Growing or developing quickly. (IELTS ≈ booming · flourishing · rapidly expanding · thriving)
words.definitionUz: burgeoning — tez o'sayotgan yoki rivojlanayotgan.
words.example1: The city has a burgeoning tech scene.
words.example1Translation: Shaharda jadal o'sayotgan texnologiya sohasi bor.
words.example2: The number of technology companies in the city is growing fast.
words.example2Translation: Shahardagi texnologiya kompaniyalari soni tez oshmoqda.
words.example3: The burgeoning middle class is spending more on travel.
words.example3Translation: Jadal o'sayotgan o'rta sinf sayohatga ko'proq pul sarflamoqda.

words.definition: To stop developing or growing. (IELTS ≈ stand still · stall · remain static · stop progressing)
words.definitionUz: stagnate — rivojlanish yoki o'sishdan to'xtamoq.
words.example1: Wages have stagnated for a decade.
words.example1Translation: Ish haqi o'n yil davomida turg'un holatda.
words.example2: Pay has not risen for ten years.
words.example2Translation: Maosh o'n yildan beri oshmagan.
words.example3: Without competition, industries tend to stagnate.
words.example3Translation: Raqobat bo'lmasa, sanoat tarmoqlari turg'unlikka tushadi.

words.definition: To stop being popular or approved of. (IELTS ≈ become unpopular · go out of fashion · lose popularity)
words.definitionUz: fall out of favour — mashhurlikni yoki ma'qullanishni yo'qotmoq.
words.example1: Coal has fallen out of favour as an energy source.
words.example1Translation: Ko'mir energiya manbai sifatida e'tibordan qoldi.
words.example2: Fewer countries now choose coal for power.
words.example2Translation: Endi kamroq davlat energiya uchun ko'mirni tanlaydi.
words.example3: The style fell out of favour in the 1970s.
words.example3Translation: Bu uslub 1970-yillarda e'tibordan qoldi.

words.definition: The current period in which species are dying out at a very fast rate because of humans. (IELTS ≈ the current wave of extinctions · biodiversity collapse)
words.definitionUz: the sixth mass extinction — inson faoliyati tufayli turlar juda tez yo'qolib borayotgan hozirgi davr.
words.example1: Many biologists believe we are living through the sixth mass extinction.
words.example1Translation: Ko'plab biologlar biz oltinchi ommaviy qirilish davrida yashayapmiz deb hisoblaydi.
words.example2: Scientists think species are disappearing faster than at almost any time in history.
words.example2Translation: Olimlar turlar tarixdagi deyarli har qanday davrdan tezroq yo'qolmoqda deb o'ylashadi.
words.example3: Habitat loss is the main driver of the sixth mass extinction.
words.example3Translation: Yashash muhitining yo'qolishi oltinchi ommaviy qirilishning asosiy sababidir.

words.definition: Using natural resources faster than the earth can replace them. (IELTS ≈ living beyond the planet's means · overconsumption of nature)
words.definitionUz: ecological overshoot — tabiiy resurslardan yer ularni tiklay olganidan tezroq foydalanish.
words.example1: Humanity has been in ecological overshoot since the 1970s.
words.example1Translation: Insoniyat 1970-yillardan beri ekologik me'yordan oshib kelmoqda.
words.example2: People have used more than nature can renew for decades.
words.example2Translation: Odamlar o'n yilliklardan beri tabiat tiklay olganidan ko'proq foydalanib kelmoqda.
words.example3: Ecological overshoot will eventually lead to shortages.
words.example3Translation: Ekologik me'yordan oshish oxir-oqibat tanqisliklarga olib keladi.

words.definition: A proposed name for the present period, when human activity shapes the planet. (IELTS ≈ the age of humans · the human-dominated era)
words.definitionUz: the Anthropocene epoch — inson faoliyati sayyorani shakllantiradigan hozirgi davr uchun taklif qilingan nom.
words.example1: Some geologists argue that we have entered the Anthropocene epoch.
words.example1Translation: Ba'zi geologlar biz antropotsen davriga kirdik deb ta'kidlaydi.
words.example2: They say humans are now the main force changing the earth.
words.example2Translation: Ular endi yerni o'zgartiruvchi asosiy kuch odamlar ekanini aytishadi.
words.example3: Plastic layers in rock may mark the Anthropocene epoch.
words.example3Translation: Tog' jinslaridagi plastik qatlamlar antropotsen davrini belgilashi mumkin.

words.translation: trofik kaskad, oziq zanjiridagi zanjirli ta'sir
words.definition: A chain of effects through a food web when a top predator is added or removed. (IELTS ≈ a food-chain ripple effect · knock-on effects in an ecosystem)
words.definitionUz: a trophic cascade — eng yuqori yirtqich qo'shilganda yoki yo'qolganda oziq zanjiri bo'ylab yuzaga keladigan ta'sirlar zanjiri.
words.example1: Returning wolves to the park triggered a trophic cascade.
words.example1Translation: Bo'rilarni bog'ga qaytarish trofik kaskadni boshlab yubordi.
words.example2: The wolves changed deer behaviour, which allowed trees and rivers to recover.
words.example2Translation: Bo'rilar bug'ular xulqini o'zgartirdi va bu daraxtlar hamda daryolarning tiklanishiga imkon berdi.
words.example3: Overfishing sharks can cause a trophic cascade.
words.example3Translation: Akulalarni haddan tashqari ovlash trofik kaskadga sabab bo'lishi mumkin.

words.definition: The way light-coloured surfaces such as ice reflect sunlight and keep the planet cooler. (IELTS ≈ reflectivity of surfaces · sunlight reflection)
words.definitionUz: the albedo effect — muz kabi och rangli yuzalarning quyosh nurini qaytarib, sayyorani sovuqroq saqlashi.
words.example1: Melting ice weakens the albedo effect and speeds up warming.
words.example1Translation: Muzning erishi albedo effektini kuchsizlantirib, isishni tezlashtiradi.
words.example2: When white ice melts, darker sea absorbs more heat.
words.example2Translation: Oq muz eriganda, qoraroq dengiz ko'proq issiqlik yutadi.
words.example3: White roofs use the albedo effect to cool buildings.
words.example3Translation: Oq tomlar binolarni sovutish uchun albedo effektidan foydalanadi.

words.definition: The melting of ground that has been frozen for a very long time. (IELTS ≈ melting frozen ground · thawing tundra)
words.definitionUz: permafrost thaw — juda uzoq vaqtdan beri muzlagan yerning erishi.
words.example1: Permafrost thaw releases large amounts of methane.
words.example1Translation: Abadiy muzloqning erishi katta miqdorda metan chiqaradi.
words.example2: As frozen soil melts, it lets out greenhouse gases.
words.example2Translation: Muzlagan tuproq eriganda issiqxona gazlarini chiqaradi.
words.example3: Roads and buildings are cracking because of permafrost thaw.
words.example3Translation: Abadiy muzloqning erishi tufayli yo'llar va binolar yorilmoqda.

words.definition: The process by which seawater becomes more acidic as it absorbs carbon dioxide. (IELTS ≈ seas becoming more acidic · falling ocean pH)
words.definitionUz: ocean acidification — dengiz suvi karbonat angidridni yutib, kislotaliroq bo'lish jarayoni.
words.example1: Ocean acidification makes it harder for corals to build reefs.
words.example1Translation: Okean kislotaliligining ortishi marjonlarga rif qurishni qiyinlashtiradi.
words.example2: More acidic water damages the skeletons of corals.
words.example2Translation: Kislotaliroq suv marjonlarning skeletiga zarar yetkazadi.
words.example3: Shellfish farms are suffering from ocean acidification.
words.example3Translation: Mollyuska fermalari okean kislotaliligining ortishidan aziyat chekmoqda.

words.definition: Projects that return land to its natural state and reintroduce wild animals. (IELTS ≈ restoring wild nature · nature restoration projects)
words.definitionUz: rewilding initiatives — yerni tabiiy holatiga qaytarib, yovvoyi hayvonlarni qayta olib kiradigan loyihalar.
words.example1: Rewilding initiatives have brought beavers back to Britain.
words.example1Translation: Tabiatni yovvoyi holiga qaytarish tashabbuslari Britaniyaga qunduzlarni qaytardi.
words.example2: Projects to restore nature have reintroduced beavers.
words.example2Translation: Tabiatni tiklash loyihalari qunduzlarni qayta olib keldi.
words.example3: Farmers are divided over rewilding initiatives.
words.example3Translation: Fermerlar tabiatni yovvoyi holiga qaytarish tashabbuslari bo'yicha turlicha fikrda.

words.definition: The particular role and position of a species in its environment. (IELTS ≈ a species' role · a habitat role · a place in the ecosystem)
words.definitionUz: an ecological niche — turning o'z muhitidagi alohida roli va o'rni.
words.example1: Each species of finch occupies a different ecological niche.
words.example1Translation: Har bir qizilishton turi alohida ekologik o'rinni egallaydi.
words.example2: The birds survive together because each eats different food.
words.example2Translation: Qushlar birga yashay oladi, chunki har biri turli ozuqa yeydi.
words.example3: Invasive species can take over an ecological niche.
words.example3Translation: Bosqinchi turlar ekologik o'rinni egallab olishi mumkin.

words.definition: Plants and animals found naturally in only one place. (IELTS ≈ native species found nowhere else · unique local wildlife)
words.definitionUz: endemic flora and fauna — tabiiy ravishda faqat bir joyda uchraydigan o'simlik va hayvonlar.
words.example1: Madagascar is famous for its endemic flora and fauna.
words.example1Translation: Madagaskar endemik o'simlik va hayvonot dunyosi bilan mashhur.
words.example2: Many of Madagascar's plants and animals exist nowhere else.
words.example2Translation: Madagaskarning ko'plab o'simlik va hayvonlari boshqa hech qayerda yo'q.
words.example3: Islands often have rich endemic flora and fauna.
words.example3Translation: Orollarda ko'pincha boy endemik o'simlik va hayvonot dunyosi bo'ladi.

words.definition: A natural area such as a forest or ocean that absorbs more carbon than it releases. (IELTS ≈ a carbon store · a natural absorber of CO2)
words.definitionUz: a carbon sink — chiqaradiganidan ko'proq uglerod yutadigan o'rmon yoki okean kabi tabiiy hudud.
words.example1: The Amazon rainforest acts as a huge carbon sink.
words.example1Translation: Amazonka tropik o'rmoni ulkan uglerod yutgichi vazifasini bajaradi.
words.example2: The forest absorbs vast amounts of carbon dioxide.
words.example2Translation: O'rmon juda katta miqdorda karbonat angidrid yutadi.
words.example3: Peat bogs are an important carbon sink.
words.example3Translation: Torf botqoqliklari muhim uglerod yutgichidir.

words.definition: The largest population an environment can support. (IELTS ≈ maximum sustainable population · environmental limit)
words.definitionUz: carrying capacity — muhit qo'llab-quvvatlay oladigan eng katta populyatsiya.
words.example1: The island has exceeded its carrying capacity for goats.
words.example1Translation: Orol echkilar uchun o'z sig'imidan oshib ketdi.
words.example2: There are now more goats than the island can feed.
words.example2Translation: Orolda endi u boqa olganidan ko'proq echki bor.
words.example3: Some scientists debate the earth's carrying capacity for humans.
words.example3Translation: Ba'zi olimlar yerning odamlar uchun sig'imi haqida bahslashadi.

words.definition: The breaking up of natural areas into small, separate pieces. (IELTS ≈ division of habitats · splitting of natural areas)
words.definitionUz: habitat fragmentation — tabiiy hududlarning kichik, alohida qismlarga bo'linishi.
words.example1: Roads cause habitat fragmentation for many animals.
words.example1Translation: Yo'llar ko'plab hayvonlar uchun yashash muhitining bo'linib ketishiga sabab bo'ladi.
words.example2: New roads cut wild areas into small isolated pieces.
words.example2Translation: Yangi yo'llar yovvoyi hududlarni kichik ajralgan bo'laklarga bo'ladi.
words.example3: Wildlife corridors help to reduce habitat fragmentation.
words.example3Translation: Yovvoyi tabiat yo'laklari yashash muhitining bo'linishini kamaytiradi.

words.definition: The large-scale destruction of the natural environment. (IELTS ≈ environmental destruction · devastation of nature)
words.definitionUz: ecocide — tabiiy muhitning keng ko'lamli yo'q qilinishi.
words.example1: Campaigners want ecocide to be recognised as an international crime.
words.example1Translation: Faollar ekotsid xalqaro jinoyat sifatida tan olinishini xohlashadi.
words.example2: Activists believe destroying nature on a huge scale should be punished in court.
words.example2Translation: Faollar tabiatni katta miqyosda yo'q qilish sudda jazolanishi kerak deb hisoblaydi.
words.example3: The oil spill was described as ecocide.
words.example3Translation: Neft to'kilishi ekotsid deb ta'riflandi.

words.definition: Having very little rain. (IELTS ≈ dry · parched · desert-like · waterless)
words.definitionUz: arid — juda kam yomg'ir yog'adigan.
words.example1: Much of Central Asia has an arid climate.
words.example1Translation: Markaziy Osiyoning katta qismi qurg'oqchil iqlimga ega.
words.example2: Large parts of the region receive very little rain.
words.example2Translation: Mintaqaning katta qismlariga juda kam yomg'ir yog'adi.
words.example3: Farming in arid regions depends on irrigation.
words.example3Translation: Qurg'oqchil mintaqalarda dehqonchilik sug'orishga bog'liq.

words.definition: In its original condition; completely unspoiled. (IELTS ≈ unspoiled · untouched · pure · immaculate)
words.definitionUz: pristine — asl holatida; butunlay buzilmagan.
words.example1: The island's pristine beaches attract many tourists.
words.example1Translation: Orolning beg'ubor plyajlari ko'plab sayyohlarni jalb qiladi.
words.example2: The beaches there are clean and untouched.
words.example2Translation: U yerdagi plyajlar toza va tegilmagan.
words.example3: Few pristine forests remain in Europe.
words.example3Translation: Yevropada kam sonli tegilmagan o'rmonlar qolgan.

words.definition: Describing a relationship in which two living things help each other. (IELTS ≈ mutually beneficial · interdependent · cooperative)
words.definitionUz: symbiotic — ikki tirik mavjudot bir-biriga yordam beradigan munosabatni ifodalovchi.
words.example1: Bees and flowers have a symbiotic relationship.
words.example1Translation: Asalarilar va gullar simbiotik munosabatda.
words.example2: Bees get food from flowers and help them reproduce.
words.example2Translation: Asalarilar gullardan ozuqa oladi va ularning ko'payishiga yordam beradi.
words.example3: The two companies formed a symbiotic partnership.
words.example3Translation: Ikki kompaniya o'zaro manfaatli hamkorlik tuzdi.

words.definition: The process of becoming completely dry. (IELTS ≈ drying out · dehydration · parching)
words.definitionUz: desiccation — butunlay qurib qolish jarayoni.
words.example1: Desiccation of the lake left fishing boats stranded in sand.
words.example1Translation: Ko'lning qurib qolishi baliqchi qayiqlarini qumda qoldirdi.
words.example2: When the lake dried up, the boats were left on dry land.
words.example2Translation: Ko'l qurigach, qayiqlar quruqlikda qolib ketdi.
words.example3: Seeds can survive years of desiccation.
words.example3Translation: Urug'lar yillab qurib qolishga bardosh bera oladi.

words.definition: A loss that can never be reversed. (IELTS ≈ a permanent loss · an irreversible loss · a loss for ever)
words.definitionUz: an irrevocable loss — hech qachon qaytarib bo'lmaydigan yo'qotish.
words.example1: The extinction of the species is an irrevocable loss.
words.example1Translation: Bu turning yo'qolib ketishi qaytarib bo'lmas yo'qotishdir.
words.example2: Once a species dies out, it can never return.
words.example2Translation: Tur yo'qolib ketgach, hech qachon qaytmaydi.
words.example3: The fire caused an irrevocable loss of ancient manuscripts.
words.example3Translation: Yong'in qadimiy qo'lyozmalarning qaytarib bo'lmas yo'qotilishiga sabab bo'ldi.

words.definition: To make something unnecessary. (IELTS ≈ remove the need for · make unnecessary · eliminate the requirement for)
words.definitionUz: obviate the need for — biror narsani keraksiz qilmoq.
words.example1: The new test obviates the need for surgery.
words.example1Translation: Yangi tahlil jarrohlikka ehtiyojni yo'qotadi.
words.example2: Patients no longer have to have an operation thanks to this test.
words.example2Translation: Bu tahlil tufayli bemorlarga endi operatsiya kerak emas.
words.example3: Online forms obviate the need for paper records.
words.example3Translation: Onlayn shakllar qog'oz hujjatlarga ehtiyojni yo'qotadi.

words.definition: A discovery that completely changes the accepted way of thinking. (IELTS ≈ a revolutionary discovery · a game-changing advance)
words.definitionUz: a paradigm-shattering breakthrough — qabul qilingan fikrlash tarzini butunlay o'zgartiradigan kashfiyot.
words.example1: The discovery of DNA's structure was a paradigm-shattering breakthrough.
words.example1Translation: DNK tuzilishining kashf etilishi qarashlarni tubdan o'zgartiruvchi kashfiyot bo'ldi.
words.example2: Understanding DNA completely changed how scientists saw life.
words.example2Translation: DNKni tushunish olimlarning hayotga qarashini butunlay o'zgartirdi.
words.example3: Researchers hope for a paradigm-shattering breakthrough in energy storage.
words.example3Translation: Tadqiqotchilar energiya saqlashda tub burilish yasaydigan kashfiyotga umid qilishmoqda.

words.definition: Computer systems whose decision-making process cannot be seen or understood. (IELTS ≈ opaque systems · unexplainable AI · hidden decision processes)
words.definitionUz: black-box algorithms — qaror qabul qilish jarayonini ko'rib yoki tushunib bo'lmaydigan kompyuter tizimlari.
words.example1: Banks are criticised for using black-box algorithms to judge loans.
words.example1Translation: Banklar qarzlarni baholashda "qora quti" algoritmlaridan foydalangani uchun tanqid qilinadi.
words.example2: Nobody can explain how the computer decides who gets a loan.
words.example2Translation: Kompyuter kimga qarz berishni qanday hal qilishini hech kim tushuntira olmaydi.
words.example3: Regulators want greater transparency in black-box algorithms.
words.example3Translation: Nazoratchilar "qora quti" algoritmlarida ko'proq shaffoflikni xohlaydi.

words.definition: The belief that technology is the main force shaping society. (IELTS ≈ the view that technology drives history)
words.definitionUz: technological determinism — texnologiya jamiyatni shakllantiruvchi asosiy kuch degan e'tiqod.
words.example1: The author rejects technological determinism.
words.example1Translation: Muallif texnologik determinizmni rad etadi.
words.example2: The writer does not think machines alone decide how society develops.
words.example2Translation: Yozuvchi jamiyat qanday rivojlanishini faqat mashinalar belgilaydi deb hisoblamaydi.
words.example3: Critics of technological determinism stress the role of politics.
words.example3Translation: Texnologik determinizm tanqidchilari siyosatning roliga urg'u beradi.

words.definition: Technology that can be used for both peaceful and military purposes. (IELTS ≈ technology with civilian and military uses)
words.definitionUz: dual-use technology — ham tinch, ham harbiy maqsadlarda ishlatilishi mumkin bo'lgan texnologiya.
words.example1: Drones are a classic example of dual-use technology.
words.example1Translation: Dronlar ikki maqsadli texnologiyaning klassik namunasidir.
words.example2: Drones can deliver parcels or be used in war.
words.example2Translation: Dronlar posilka yetkazishi yoki urushda ishlatilishi mumkin.
words.example3: Exports of dual-use technology are strictly controlled.
words.example3Translation: Ikki maqsadli texnologiya eksporti qat'iy nazorat qilinadi.

words.translation: haptik javob, sezgi orqali qaytma aloqa
words.definition: Technology that communicates through touch, such as vibrations. (IELTS ≈ touch feedback · vibration response · tactile response)
words.definitionUz: haptic feedback — tebranish kabi teginish orqali ma'lumot beradigan texnologiya.
words.example1: The game controller uses haptic feedback to make play feel real.
words.example1Translation: O'yin boshqaruvchisi o'yinni real his qildirish uchun haptik javobdan foydalanadi.
words.example2: The controller vibrates so that players feel what happens on screen.
words.example2Translation: Boshqaruvchi tebranib, o'yinchilarga ekranda nima bo'layotganini his qildiradi.
words.example3: Surgeons use haptic feedback when operating robots remotely.
words.example3Translation: Jarrohlar robotlarni masofadan boshqarganda haptik javobdan foydalanadi.

words.definition: The design and building of new biological parts and organisms. (IELTS ≈ bioengineering · designing living systems)
words.definitionUz: synthetic biology — yangi biologik qismlar va organizmlarni loyihalash va yaratish.
words.example1: Synthetic biology could produce fuel from bacteria.
words.example1Translation: Sintetik biologiya bakteriyalardan yoqilg'i ishlab chiqarishi mumkin.
words.example2: Scientists may design microbes that make fuel.
