words.example3: Depression and anxiety are often comorbid conditions.
words.example3Translation: Depressiya va xavotir ko'pincha yondosh kasalliklardir.

words.definition: Changes in how genes work that do not alter the DNA itself. (IELTS ≈ changes in gene expression · heritable gene changes)
words.definitionUz: epigenetic modifications — DNKning o'zini o'zgartirmaydigan, genlar ishlashidagi o'zgarishlar.
words.example1: Diet and stress can cause epigenetic modifications.
words.example1Translation: Ovqatlanish va stress epigenetik o'zgarishlarga sabab bo'lishi mumkin.
words.example2: Our lifestyle can switch genes on or off without changing DNA.
words.example2Translation: Turmush tarzimiz DNKni o'zgartirmasdan genlarni yoqishi yoki o'chirishi mumkin.
words.example3: Some epigenetic modifications may be passed to children.
words.example3Translation: Ba'zi epigenetik o'zgarishlar bolalarga o'tishi mumkin.

words.definition: The process by which stem cells become specialised cells such as nerve or muscle cells. (IELTS ≈ cell specialisation · stem cell development)
words.definitionUz: stem cell differentiation — o'zak hujayralarning nerv yoki mushak hujayralari kabi ixtisoslashgan hujayralarga aylanish jarayoni.
words.example1: Scientists can now control stem cell differentiation in the lab.
words.example1Translation: Olimlar endi laboratoriyada o'zak hujayralarning differensiatsiyasini boshqara oladi.
words.example2: Researchers can turn basic cells into specific tissues.
words.example2Translation: Tadqiqotchilar oddiy hujayralarni ma'lum to'qimalarga aylantira oladi.
words.example3: Understanding stem cell differentiation may help repair damaged organs.
words.example3Translation: O'zak hujayralar differensiatsiyasini tushunish shikastlangan a'zolarni tiklashga yordam berishi mumkin.

words.definition: People whose immune system is weak. (IELTS ≈ patients with weak immunity · vulnerable patients)
words.definitionUz: immunocompromised patients — immun tizimi zaif odamlar.
words.example1: Immunocompromised patients are more at risk from infections.
words.example1Translation: Immuniteti zaiflashgan bemorlar infeksiyalardan ko'proq xavf ostida.
words.example2: People with weak defences catch infections more easily.
words.example2Translation: Himoyasi zaif odamlar infeksiyalarni osonroq yuqtiradi.
words.example3: Chemotherapy can leave patients immunocompromised.
words.example3Translation: Kimyoterapiya bemorlarning immunitetini zaiflashtirishi mumkin.

words.definition: Treatment given to prevent a disease rather than cure it. (IELTS ≈ preventive treatment · preventative medicine)
words.definitionUz: prophylactic treatment — kasallikni davolash emas, uning oldini olish uchun beriladigan davolash.
words.example1: Travellers take prophylactic treatment against malaria.
words.example1Translation: Sayohatchilar bezgakka qarshi profilaktik davolanishdan o'tadi.
words.example2: People going to certain countries take medicine to avoid malaria.
words.example2Translation: Ba'zi mamlakatlarga boradiganlar bezgakdan saqlanish uchun dori ichadi.
words.example3: Prophylactic treatment can reduce the risk of infection after surgery.
words.example3Translation: Profilaktik davolash operatsiyadan keyin infeksiya xavfini kamaytiradi.

words.definition: An illness that makes a person very weak and unable to do normal things. (IELTS ≈ a disabling illness · a crippling disease · a weakening condition)
words.definitionUz: a debilitating condition — insonni juda zaif qilib, odatiy ishlarni qila olmaydigan qiladigan kasallik.
words.example1: Chronic fatigue can be a debilitating condition.
words.example1Translation: Surunkali charchoq holdan toydiruvchi kasallik bo'lishi mumkin.
words.example2: Some people with constant tiredness cannot work or study.
words.example2Translation: Doimiy charchoqqa uchragan ba'zi odamlar ishlay yoki o'qiy olmaydi.
words.example3: Arthritis is a debilitating condition for millions.
words.example3Translation: Artrit millionlab odamlar uchun holdan toydiruvchi kasallikdir.

words.definition: To die from a disease. (IELTS ≈ die of · be overcome by · lose a battle with)
words.definitionUz: succumb to an illness — kasallik tufayli vafot etmoq.
words.example1: The poet succumbed to an illness at the age of forty.
words.example1Translation: Shoir qirq yoshida kasallikdan vafot etdi.
words.example2: He died from a disease when he was forty.
words.example2Translation: U qirq yoshida kasallikdan vafot etdi.
words.example3: Many soldiers succumbed to illness rather than wounds.
words.example3Translation: Ko'plab askarlar jarohatdan emas, kasallikdan vafot etgan.

words.definition: A shift in the main causes of death from infectious to chronic diseases. (IELTS ≈ a change in disease patterns · a health transition)
words.definitionUz: an epidemiological transition — asosiy o'lim sabablarining yuqumli kasalliklardan surunkali kasalliklarga o'tishi.
words.example1: Many countries have gone through an epidemiological transition.
words.example1Translation: Ko'plab mamlakatlar epidemiologik o'tishni boshdan kechirgan.
words.example2: Fewer people now die of infections and more of heart disease.
words.example2Translation: Endi kamroq odam infeksiyadan, ko'proq odam yurak kasalligidan vafot etadi.
words.example3: Rising incomes often lead to an epidemiological transition.
words.example3Translation: Daromadlarning oshishi ko'pincha epidemiologik o'tishga olib keladi.

words.definition: Diseases in which the immune system attacks the body's own cells. (IELTS ≈ immune system diseases · self-attacking conditions)
words.definitionUz: autoimmune disorders — immun tizimi organizmning o'z hujayralariga hujum qiladigan kasalliklar.
words.example1: Autoimmune disorders are more common in women.
words.example1Translation: Autoimmun kasalliklar ayollarda ko'proq uchraydi.
words.example2: Women more often have diseases where the body attacks itself.
words.example2Translation: Ayollarda organizm o'ziga hujum qiladigan kasalliklar ko'proq uchraydi.
words.example3: Researchers are studying why autoimmune disorders are rising.
words.example3Translation: Tadqiqotchilar autoimmun kasalliklar nima uchun ko'payayotganini o'rganmoqda.

words.definition: A report saying that someone is healthy or something is in good condition. (IELTS ≈ a positive health report · official approval)
words.definitionUz: a clean bill of health — kimdir sog'lom yoki biror narsa yaxshi holatda ekanini bildiruvchi xulosa.
words.example1: After the tests, the doctor gave him a clean bill of health.
words.example1Translation: Tahlillardan keyin shifokor uni sog'lom deb topdi.
words.example2: The doctor said he was completely healthy.
words.example2Translation: Shifokor u butunlay sog'lom ekanini aytdi.
words.example3: Inspectors gave the factory a clean bill of health.
words.example3Translation: Inspektorlar zavodni talablarga to'liq mos deb topdi.

words.definition: The rate of disease in a population. (IELTS ≈ rate of illness · disease prevalence · sickness rate)
words.definitionUz: morbidity — aholidagi kasallik darajasi.
words.example1: Smoking increases both morbidity and mortality.
words.example1Translation: Chekish kasallanish va o'lim darajasini oshiradi.
words.example2: Smokers are more likely to become ill and to die early.
words.example2Translation: Chekuvchilar kasal bo'lish va erta vafot etish ehtimoli ko'proq.
words.example3: Obesity is linked to high morbidity.
words.example3Translation: Semizlik yuqori kasallanish darajasi bilan bog'liq.

words.definition: The spread of disease by close contact, or the spread of a harmful idea. (IELTS ≈ infection · transmission · spread · contamination)
words.definitionUz: contagion — yaqin aloqa orqali kasallikning yoki zararli g'oyaning tarqalishi.
words.example1: Doctors wore masks to prevent contagion.
words.example1Translation: Shifokorlar yuqishning oldini olish uchun niqob taqishdi.
words.example2: Masks stopped the disease passing between people.
words.example2Translation: Niqoblar kasallikning odamdan odamga o'tishini to'xtatdi.
words.example3: Economists fear financial contagion spreading to other countries.
words.example3Translation: Iqtisodchilar moliyaviy inqirozning boshqa mamlakatlarga yuqishidan qo'rqishadi.

words.definition: The study of diseases, or the signs of a disease in the body. (IELTS ≈ study of disease · disease process · abnormality)
words.definitionUz: pathology — kasalliklarni o'rganish yoki tanadagi kasallik belgilari.
words.example1: The tissue was sent to the pathology lab.
words.example1Translation: To'qima patologiya laboratoriyasiga yuborildi.
words.example2: Experts examined the sample to find signs of disease.
words.example2Translation: Mutaxassislar kasallik belgilarini topish uchun namunani tekshirishdi.
words.example3: Pathology results showed the tumour was benign.
words.example3Translation: Patologiya natijalari o'sma xavfsiz ekanini ko'rsatdi.

words.definition: Not harmful, especially describing a tumour that is not cancer. (IELTS ≈ harmless · non-cancerous · non-malignant · mild)
words.definitionUz: benign — zararsiz, ayniqsa saraton bo'lmagan o'smani ta'riflovchi.
words.example1: Fortunately, the tumour was benign.
words.example1Translation: Baxtimizga, o'sma xavfsiz edi.
words.example2: The growth was not cancer and was not dangerous.
words.example2Translation: O'sma saraton emas edi va xavfli emasdi.
words.example3: The climate here is relatively benign.
words.example3Translation: Bu yerdagi iqlim nisbatan mo'tadil.

words.definition: A solution claimed to solve all problems. (IELTS ≈ a cure-all for · a universal remedy for · a magic solution to)
words.definitionUz: a panacea for — barcha muammolarni hal qiladi deb da'vo qilinadigan yechim.
words.example1: Technology is not a panacea for poor education.
words.example1Translation: Texnologiya yomon ta'lim uchun har dardga davo emas.
words.example2: Computers alone cannot fix problems in schools.
words.example2Translation: Kompyuterlarning o'zi maktablardagi muammolarni hal qila olmaydi.
words.example3: Exercise is often promoted as a panacea for stress.
words.example3Translation: Jismoniy mashq ko'pincha stress uchun har dardga davo sifatida targ'ib qilinadi.

words.definition: Harmful effects. (IELTS ≈ harmful effects · damaging consequences · detrimental impact)
words.definitionUz: deleterious effects — zararli ta'sirlar.
words.example1: Lack of sleep has deleterious effects on memory.
words.example1Translation: Uyqu yetishmasligi xotiraga zararli ta'sir ko'rsatadi.
words.example2: Not sleeping enough damages your ability to remember.
words.example2Translation: Yetarlicha uxlamaslik eslab qolish qobiliyatingizga zarar yetkazadi.
words.example3: Scientists are studying the deleterious effects of microplastics.
words.example3Translation: Olimlar mikroplastiklarning zararli ta'sirlarini o'rganmoqda.

words.definition: The rising level of qualifications needed for jobs that once required less. (IELTS ≈ degree inflation · qualification creep)
words.definitionUz: credential inflation — ilgari kamroq talab qilingan ishlar uchun kerakli malaka darajasining oshishi.
words.example1: Credential inflation means many jobs now require a degree.
words.example1Translation: Diplomlar qadrsizlanishi tufayli endi ko'plab ishlar oliy ma'lumotni talab qiladi.
words.example2: Jobs that once needed school certificates now ask for university degrees.
words.example2Translation: Ilgari maktab attestati yetarli bo'lgan ishlar endi oliy ma'lumot so'raydi.
words.example3: Critics say credential inflation wastes students' time and money.
words.example3Translation: Tanqidchilar diplomlar qadrsizlanishi talabalarning vaqti va pulini isrof qiladi deyishadi.

words.definition: The desire to gain new knowledge and understanding. (IELTS ≈ intellectual curiosity · thirst for knowledge)
words.definitionUz: epistemic curiosity — yangi bilim va tushuncha olishga intilish.
words.example1: Good questions spark epistemic curiosity in learners.
words.example1Translation: Yaxshi savollar o'rganuvchilarda bilimga chanqoqlik uyg'otadi.
words.example2: Clever questions make students want to find out more.
words.example2Translation: Aqlli savollar talabalarda ko'proq bilish istagini uyg'otadi.
words.example3: Epistemic curiosity is linked to better long-term memory.
words.example3Translation: Bilimga chanqoqlik yaxshiroq uzoq muddatli xotira bilan bog'liq.

words.definition: Students who take responsibility for their own learning. (IELTS ≈ independent learners · self-directed students)
words.definitionUz: autonomous learners — o'z ta'limi uchun mas'uliyatni o'z zimmasiga oladigan o'quvchilar.
words.example1: The course aims to produce autonomous learners.
words.example1Translation: Kurs mustaqil o'rganuvchilarni tayyorlashni maqsad qiladi.
words.example2: Students are taught to manage their own studies.
words.example2Translation: Talabalarga o'z o'qishlarini boshqarish o'rgatiladi.
words.example3: Autonomous learners set their own goals.
words.example3Translation: Mustaqil o'rganuvchilar o'z maqsadlarini o'zlari belgilaydi.

words.definition: Asking a series of questions to help someone think deeply and examine ideas. (IELTS ≈ probing questions · guided inquiry)
words.definitionUz: Socratic questioning — kimgadir chuqur o'ylash va g'oyalarni tekshirishga yordam berish uchun bir qator savollar berish.
words.example1: The teacher used Socratic questioning to challenge assumptions.
words.example1Translation: O'qituvchi taxminlarga e'tiroz bildirish uchun Suqrotona savol berishdan foydalandi.
words.example2: By asking question after question, she made students rethink their views.
words.example2Translation: Ketma-ket savollar berib, u o'quvchilarni o'z qarashlarini qayta ko'rib chiqishga majbur qildi.
words.example3: Socratic questioning encourages critical thinking.
words.example3Translation: Suqrotona savol berish tanqidiy fikrlashni rag'batlantiradi.

words.definition: Teaching in which the teacher talks and students listen. (IELTS ≈ teacher-led instruction · lecturing · direct teaching)
words.definitionUz: didactic instruction — o'qituvchi gapirib, o'quvchilar tinglaydigan o'qitish.
words.example1: Didactic instruction is still common in many schools.
words.example1Translation: Didaktik o'qitish ko'plab maktablarda hamon keng tarqalgan.
words.example2: In many classrooms, the teacher mainly talks and pupils listen.
words.example2Translation: Ko'plab sinflarda asosan o'qituvchi gapiradi, o'quvchilar tinglaydi.
words.example3: Critics argue that didactic instruction limits creativity.
words.example3Translation: Tanqidchilar didaktik o'qitish ijodkorlikni cheklaydi deb ta'kidlashadi.

words.definition: To develop the ability to analyse and judge things sharply. (IELTS ≈ develop sharp analytical skills · sharpen judgement)
words.definitionUz: cultivate analytical acumen — narsalarni o'tkir tahlil qilish va baholash qobiliyatini rivojlantirmoq.
words.example1: Case studies help business students cultivate analytical acumen.
words.example1Translation: Amaliy holatlar biznes talabalariga tahliliy ziyraklikni rivojlantirishga yordam beradi.
words.example2: Examining real cases sharpens students' ability to analyse.
words.example2Translation: Haqiqiy holatlarni o'rganish talabalarning tahlil qilish qobiliyatini o'tkirlashtiradi.
words.example3: Chess can cultivate analytical acumen.
words.example3Translation: Shaxmat tahliliy ziyraklikni rivojlantirishi mumkin.

words.definition: The values and behaviour students learn at school without being formally taught. (IELTS ≈ unwritten lessons · implicit learning at school)
words.definitionUz: the hidden curriculum — o'quvchilar maktabda rasman o'rgatilmasdan o'rganadigan qadriyat va xatti-harakatlar.
words.example1: Punctuality is part of the hidden curriculum.
words.example1Translation: Vaqtga rioya qilish yashirin o'quv dasturining bir qismi.
words.example2: Pupils learn to be on time even though it is not a subject.
words.example2Translation: O'quvchilar bu fan bo'lmasa ham vaqtida kelishni o'rganishadi.
words.example3: The hidden curriculum can reinforce social inequality.
words.example3Translation: Yashirin o'quv dasturi ijtimoiy tengsizlikni kuchaytirishi mumkin.

words.definition: A method in which people must succeed alone without help. (IELTS ≈ being left to cope alone · trial by fire)
words.definitionUz: a sink-or-swim approach — odamlar yordamisiz o'zlari muvaffaqiyatga erishishlari kerak bo'lgan usul.
words.example1: New employees were given a sink-or-swim approach to training.
words.example1Translation: Yangi xodimlarga "yo cho'k, yo suz" tarzida o'qitish berildi.
words.example2: New staff had to learn on their own without support.
words.example2Translation: Yangi xodimlar yordamisiz o'zlari o'rganishlari kerak edi.
words.example3: A sink-or-swim approach does not suit every student.
words.example3Translation: "Yo cho'k, yo suz" yondashuvi har bir talabaga mos kelmaydi.

words.definition: To learn gradually, without deliberate effort, by being around something. (IELTS ≈ pick up naturally · absorb gradually · learn through exposure)
words.definitionUz: learn by osmosis — biror narsa atrofida bo'lish orqali, maxsus harakatsiz asta-sekin o'rganmoq.
words.example1: Children often learn a second language by osmosis.
words.example1Translation: Bolalar ko'pincha ikkinchi tilni beixtiyor o'zlashtiradi.
words.example2: Kids pick up languages simply by hearing them around them.
words.example2Translation: Bolalar tillarni atrofida eshitish orqali o'zlashtiradi.
words.example3: You cannot learn grammar by osmosis alone.
words.example3Translation: Grammatikani faqat beixtiyor o'zlashtirib bo'lmaydi.

words.definition: A good basic knowledge of a subject. (IELTS ≈ a good foundation in · a firm basis in · basic training in)
words.definitionUz: a solid grounding in — biror fan bo'yicha yaxshi asosiy bilim.
words.example1: The course gives students a solid grounding in statistics.
words.example1Translation: Kurs talabalarga statistika bo'yicha mustahkam asos beradi.
words.example2: Students finish the course with a good basic knowledge of statistics.
words.example2Translation: Talabalar kursni statistika bo'yicha yaxshi asosiy bilim bilan tugatadi.
words.example3: A solid grounding in maths helps in many careers.
words.example3Translation: Matematika bo'yicha mustahkam asos ko'plab kasblarda yordam beradi.

words.definition: To be full of a particular quality or influenced by it deeply. (IELTS ≈ be immersed in · be rich in · be full of)
words.definitionUz: be steeped in — biror xususiyatga to'la yoki undan chuqur ta'sirlangan bo'lmoq.
words.example1: Bukhara is steeped in history.
words.example1Translation: Buxoro tarixga chuqur singgan.
words.example2: The city is full of historical buildings and stories.
words.example2Translation: Shahar tarixiy binolar va hikoyalarga to'la.
words.example3: She was steeped in classical music from childhood.
words.example3Translation: U bolaligidan klassik musiqaga chuqur singib o'sgan.

words.definition: To give students so much help that they do not have to think for themselves. (IELTS ≈ over-help learners · give ready-made answers)
words.definitionUz: spoon-feed students — talabalarga shunchalik ko'p yordam berishki, ular o'zlari o'ylamasligi.
words.example1: Universities complain that schools spoon-feed students.
words.example1Translation: Universitetlar maktablar o'quvchilarga tayyor bilim beradi deb shikoyat qiladi.
words.example2: Pupils are given all the answers instead of working them out.
words.example2Translation: O'quvchilarga javoblarni o'zlari topish o'rniga hammasi tayyor beriladi.
words.example3: If you spoon-feed students, they cannot work independently.
words.example3Translation: Talabalarga tayyor bilim bersangiz, ular mustaqil ishlay olmaydi.

words.translation: "fil suyagi minorasi", hayotdan uzilgan akademik muhit
words.definition: A situation in which academics are separated from the practical problems of ordinary life. (IELTS ≈ academic isolation · detachment from reality)
words.definitionUz: the ivory tower — akademiklar oddiy hayotning amaliy muammolaridan uzilgan vaziyat.
words.example1: Critics say economists live in an ivory tower.
words.example1Translation: Tanqidchilar iqtisodchilar hayotdan uzilgan muhitda yashaydi deyishadi.
words.example2: Some believe academics do not understand real people's problems.
words.example2Translation: Ba'zilar akademiklar oddiy odamlarning muammolarini tushunmaydi deb hisoblaydi.
words.example3: The professor left the ivory tower to work with farmers.
words.example3Translation: Professor akademik muhitni tark etib, dehqonlar bilan ishlay boshladi.

words.definition: To focus teaching only on what will be examined. (IELTS ≈ focus only on exam content · exam-driven teaching)
words.definitionUz: teach to the test — o'qitishni faqat imtihonda so'raladigan narsalarga qaratmoq.
words.example1: Many teachers feel pressure to teach to the test.
words.example1Translation: Ko'plab o'qituvchilar faqat imtihonga tayyorlab o'qitish bosimini his qiladi.
words.example2: Teachers often concentrate only on what exams will ask.
words.example2Translation: O'qituvchilar ko'pincha faqat imtihonda nima so'ralishiga e'tibor qaratadi.
words.example3: If schools teach to the test, deeper learning suffers.
words.example3Translation: Maktablar faqat imtihonga tayyorlasa, chuqur o'rganish zarar ko'radi.

words.definition: Having or showing great knowledge from study. (IELTS ≈ learned · scholarly · well-read · knowledgeable)
words.definitionUz: erudite — o'qish orqali olingan katta bilimga ega.
words.example1: The professor gave an erudite lecture on Persian poetry.
words.example1Translation: Professor fors she'riyati haqida chuqur bilimli ma'ruza qildi.
words.example2: The talk showed the speaker's deep knowledge.
words.example2Translation: Ma'ruza notiqning chuqur bilimini ko'rsatdi.
words.example3: He was an erudite man who spoke six languages.
words.example3Translation: U olti tilda gaplasha oladigan bilimdon inson edi.

words.definition: Too concerned with small details or rules. (IELTS ≈ overly precise · nit-picking · fussy · hair-splitting)
words.definitionUz: pedantic — mayda tafsilotlar yoki qoidalarga haddan tashqari e'tibor beradigan.
words.example1: It may sound pedantic, but the date in the report is wrong.
words.example1Translation: Mayda gap bo'lib tuyulishi mumkin, lekin hisobotdagi sana noto'g'ri.
words.example2: This is a small point, but the detail is incorrect.
words.example2Translation: Bu kichik masala, lekin tafsilot noto'g'ri.
words.example3: Students found the teacher pedantic about spelling.
words.example3Translation: O'quvchilar o'qituvchini imlo masalasida mayda-chuydaga yopishuvchi deb bilishdi.

words.definition: A person who knows a lot about many different subjects. (IELTS ≈ all-round scholar · universal genius · Renaissance person)
words.definitionUz: polymath — ko'plab turli fanlar bo'yicha ko'p narsa biladigan inson.
words.example1: Ibn Sina was a polymath who wrote on medicine and philosophy.
words.example1Translation: Ibn Sino tibbiyot va falsafa haqida yozgan qomusiy olim edi.
words.example2: He was an expert in many fields, from medicine to philosophy.
words.example2Translation: U tibbiyotdan falsafagacha ko'plab sohalarda mutaxassis edi.
words.example3: Leonardo da Vinci is the best-known polymath in history.
words.example3Translation: Leonardo da Vinchi tarixdagi eng mashhur qomusiy olimdir.

words.definition: A person who has taught themselves rather than receiving formal education. (IELTS ≈ self-taught person · self-educated learner)
words.definitionUz: autodidact — rasmiy ta'lim olmasdan o'zini o'zi o'qitgan inson.
words.example1: The famous inventor was an autodidact who left school at twelve.
words.example1Translation: Mashhur ixtirochi o'n ikki yoshida maktabni tashlab, o'zini o'zi o'qitgan.
words.example2: He taught himself almost everything he knew.
words.example2Translation: U bilgan deyarli hamma narsani o'zi o'rgangan.
words.example3: The internet has created a new generation of autodidacts.
words.example3Translation: Internet o'zini o'zi o'qitgan odamlarning yangi avlodini yaratdi.

words.definition: Having developed abilities at an unusually early age. (IELTS ≈ advanced for one's age · gifted · mature beyond one's years)
words.definitionUz: precocious — g'ayrioddiy erta yoshda qobiliyatlarni rivojlantirgan.
words.example1: Mozart was a precocious child who composed music at five.
words.example1Translation: Motsart besh yoshida musiqa bastalagan iqtidorli bola edi.
words.example2: He was writing music when most children are just learning to read.
words.example2Translation: U ko'pchilik bolalar o'qishni endigina o'rganayotgan yoshda musiqa yozgan.
words.example3: The precocious student finished university at sixteen.
words.example3Translation: Iqtidorli talaba o'n olti yoshida universitetni tugatdi.

words.definition: A person who is interested in a subject but does not study it seriously. (IELTS ≈ amateur · dabbler · non-professional · trifler)
words.definitionUz: dilettante — biror fanga qiziqadigan, lekin uni jiddiy o'rganmaydigan inson.
words.example1: Critics dismissed him as a dilettante rather than a true scholar.
words.example1Translation: Tanqidchilar uni haqiqiy olim emas, yuzaki biluvchi deb rad etishdi.
words.example2: They said he only played at the subject without real expertise.
words.example2Translation: Ular u haqiqiy bilimsiz faqat qiziqish uchun shug'ullanadi deyishdi.
words.example3: She was no dilettante; she had studied the subject for decades.
words.example3Translation: U havaskor emas edi; bu fanni o'n yilliklar davomida o'rgangan.

words.definition: To know a lot about a subject. (IELTS ≈ be knowledgeable about · be experienced in · be familiar with)
words.definitionUz: be well versed in — biror fan haqida ko'p narsa bilmoq.
words.example1: The new manager is well versed in international law.
words.example1Translation: Yangi menejer xalqaro huquqni yaxshi biladi.
words.example2: She has a deep knowledge of law between countries.
words.example2Translation: U davlatlararo huquqni chuqur biladi.
words.example3: Guides must be well versed in local history.
words.example3Translation: Gidlar mahalliy tarixni yaxshi bilishi kerak.

words.definition: To teach values by repeating them often until they are accepted. (IELTS ≈ instil values · teach principles · ingrain beliefs)
words.definitionUz: inculcate values — qadriyatlarni qabul qilinguncha tez-tez takrorlash orqali o'rgatmoq.
words.example1: Schools aim to inculcate values such as honesty and respect.
words.example1Translation: Maktablar halollik va hurmat kabi qadriyatlarni singdirishni maqsad qiladi.
words.example2: Pupils are taught again and again to be honest and respectful.
words.example2Translation: O'quvchilarga qayta-qayta halol va hurmatli bo'lish o'rgatiladi.
words.example3: Parents try to inculcate values from an early age.
words.example3Translation: Ota-onalar qadriyatlarni erta yoshdan singdirishga harakat qiladi.

words.definition: Freedom from punishment. (IELTS ≈ exemption from punishment · freedom from consequences)
words.definitionUz: impunity — jazodan ozod bo'lish.
words.example1: Corrupt officials acted with impunity for years.
words.example1Translation: Korrupsiyachi mansabdorlar yillar davomida jazosiz harakat qilishdi.
words.example2: For a long time, dishonest officials were never punished.
words.example2Translation: Uzoq vaqt davomida nohalol mansabdorlar hech qachon jazolanmadi.
words.example3: Strong courts help to end impunity.
words.example3Translation: Kuchli sudlar jazosizlikka barham berishga yordam beradi.

words.definition: A situation in which a regulator serves the interests of the industry it controls. (IELTS ≈ industry control of regulators · captured oversight)
words.definitionUz: regulatory capture — nazoratchi organ o'zi nazorat qiladigan soha manfaatlariga xizmat qiladigan vaziyat.
words.example1: Critics accused the agency of regulatory capture by oil companies.
words.example1Translation: Tanqidchilar agentlikni neft kompaniyalari tomonidan egallab olinganlikda ayblashdi.
words.example2: The regulator seemed to protect oil firms rather than the public.
words.example2Translation: Nazoratchi jamoatchilikni emas, neft firmalarini himoya qilgandek tuyuldi.
words.example3: Regulatory capture weakens public trust.
words.example3Translation: Nazoratchining egallab olinishi jamoatchilik ishonchini zaiflashtiradi.

words.definition: A government using more power than the law allows. (IELTS ≈ abuse of executive power · exceeding authority)
words.definitionUz: executive overreach — hukumatning qonun ruxsat berganidan ko'proq hokimiyatdan foydalanishi.
words.example1: The court ruled that the decree was executive overreach.
words.example1Translation: Sud farmonni ijroiya hokimiyatning vakolatdan oshishi deb topdi.
words.example2: Judges said the government had gone beyond its legal powers.
words.example2Translation: Sudyalar hukumat qonuniy vakolatlaridan oshib ketganini aytishdi.
words.example3: Parliament must guard against executive overreach.
words.example3Translation: Parlament ijroiya hokimiyatning vakolatdan oshishiga qarshi turishi kerak.

words.definition: A situation in which lawmakers cannot agree, so no laws are passed. (IELTS ≈ political deadlock · parliamentary stalemate)
words.definitionUz: legislative gridlock — qonun chiqaruvchilar kelisha olmagani uchun hech qanday qonun qabul qilinmaydigan vaziyat.
words.example1: Legislative gridlock has delayed the budget for months.
words.example1Translation: Qonunchilikdagi turg'unlik byudjetni oylab kechiktirdi.
words.example2: Lawmakers could not agree, so the budget was not passed.
words.example2Translation: Qonun chiqaruvchilar kelisha olmadi va byudjet qabul qilinmadi.
words.example3: Voters are frustrated by legislative gridlock.
words.example3Translation: Saylovchilar qonunchilikdagi turg'unlikdan norozi.

words.definition: A law that applies to actions taken before it was passed. (IELTS ≈ backdated law · retrospective legislation)
words.definitionUz: retroactive legislation — qabul qilinishidan oldin qilingan harakatlarga ham tatbiq etiladigan qonun.
words.example1: Retroactive legislation is seen as unfair in most legal systems.
words.example1Translation: Orqaga qaytuvchi kuchga ega qonun ko'pchilik huquq tizimlarida adolatsiz hisoblanadi.
words.example2: Punishing people for acts that were legal at the time seems unjust.
words.example2Translation: O'sha paytda qonuniy bo'lgan harakatlar uchun jazolash adolatsiz tuyuladi.
words.example3: The tax change was introduced as retroactive legislation.
words.example3Translation: Soliq o'zgarishi orqaga qaytuvchi kuchga ega qonun sifatida joriy etildi.

words.definition: A legal duty to act in the best interests of another person. (IELTS ≈ a duty of trust · a legal obligation to act faithfully)
words.definitionUz: a fiduciary duty — boshqa shaxsning manfaatlari yo'lida harakat qilish huquqiy majburiyati.
words.example1: Company directors have a fiduciary duty to shareholders.
words.example1Translation: Kompaniya direktorlari aksiyadorlar oldida ishonchga asoslangan majburiyatga ega.
words.example2: Directors must act in the best interests of the owners.
words.example2Translation: Direktorlar egalar manfaati yo'lida harakat qilishlari shart.
words.example3: The lawyer breached his fiduciary duty.
words.example3Translation: Advokat ishonchga asoslangan majburiyatini buzdi.

words.definition: A court decision that will guide future cases. (IELTS ≈ a landmark judgement · a groundbreaking decision)
words.definitionUz: a precedent-setting ruling — kelajakdagi ishlar uchun yo'l ko'rsatadigan sud qarori.
words.example1: The court issued a precedent-setting ruling on data privacy.
words.example1Translation: Sud shaxsiy ma'lumotlar maxfiyligi bo'yicha pretsedent yaratuvchi qaror chiqardi.
words.example2: Future cases about personal data will follow this decision.
words.example2Translation: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlar haqidagi kelajakdagi ishlar shu qarorga amal qiladi.
words.example3: Lawyers called it a precedent-setting ruling.
words.example3Translation: Advokatlar buni pretsedent yaratuvchi qaror deb atashdi.

words.definition: To write traditional unwritten rules into a formal legal code. (IELTS ≈ write down traditional law · formalise customs)
words.definitionUz: codify customary law — an'anaviy yozilmagan qoidalarni rasmiy huquqiy kodeksga kiritmoq.
words.example1: Colonial rulers tried to codify customary law.
words.example1Translation: Mustamlakachi hukmdorlar odat huquqini kodlashtirishga harakat qilishgan.
words.example2: They wrote down local traditions as official laws.
words.example2Translation: Ular mahalliy an'analarni rasmiy qonunlar sifatida yozib olishgan.
words.example3: Codifying customary law can make it less flexible.
words.example3Translation: Odat huquqini kodlashtirish uni kamroq moslashuvchan qilishi mumkin.

words.definition: The fair legal procedures that must be followed before someone is punished. (IELTS ≈ fair legal procedure · the right to a fair hearing)
words.definitionUz: due process — kimdir jazolanishidan oldin rioya qilinishi kerak bo'lgan adolatli huquqiy tartib.
words.example1: Everyone has the right to due process.
words.example1Translation: Har kim qonuniy tartibga bo'lgan huquqqa ega.
words.example2: Nobody should be punished without a fair legal process.
words.example2Translation: Hech kim adolatli huquqiy jarayonsiz jazolanmasligi kerak.
words.example3: The prisoners were held without due process.
words.example3Translation: Mahbuslar qonuniy tartibsiz ushlab turildi.

words.definition: A situation where it is unclear what the law allows. (IELTS ≈ an uncertain area of law · a legal loophole)
words.definitionUz: a legal grey area — qonun nimaga ruxsat berishi noaniq bo'lgan vaziyat.
words.example1: Flying drones over private homes is a legal grey area.
words.example1Translation: Shaxsiy uylar ustidan dron uchirish qonunda noaniq soha.
words.example2: The law does not clearly say whether this is allowed.
words.example2Translation: Qonun bunga ruxsat berilganmi yoki yo'qligini aniq aytmaydi.
words.example3: New technologies often operate in a legal grey area.
words.example3Translation: Yangi texnologiyalar ko'pincha qonunda noaniq sohada ishlaydi.

words.definition: The exact words of a law rather than its general purpose. (IELTS ≈ the strict wording of the law · a literal reading of the law)
words.definitionUz: the letter of the law — qonunning umumiy maqsadi emas, aniq so'zlari.
words.example1: The company followed the letter of the law but not its spirit.
words.example1Translation: Kompaniya qonunning so'zma-so'z talabiga amal qildi, lekin uning ruhiga emas.
words.example2: The firm did what the rules said but ignored their purpose.
words.example2Translation: Firma qoidalar aytganini qildi, lekin ularning maqsadini e'tiborsiz qoldirdi.
words.example3: Judges sometimes look beyond the letter of the law.
words.example3Translation: Sudyalar ba'zan qonunning so'zma-so'z talabidan nariga qarashadi.

words.definition: To make a right or principle officially protected by law. (IELTS ≈ guarantee by law · establish legally · make law)
words.definitionUz: enshrine in law — huquq yoki tamoyilni qonun bilan rasman himoya qilmoq.
words.example1: The right to free education is enshrined in law.
words.example1Translation: Bepul ta'lim olish huquqi qonunda mustahkamlangan.
words.example2: The law officially guarantees free schooling.
words.example2Translation: Qonun bepul ta'limni rasman kafolatlaydi.
words.example3: Campaigners want equal pay to be enshrined in law.
words.example3Translation: Faollar teng ish haqi qonunda mustahkamlanishini xohlashadi.

words.definition: To break a rule or get into trouble with someone in authority. (IELTS ≈ break · violate · run into trouble with · offend)
words.definitionUz: fall foul of — qoidani buzmoq yoki hokimiyat bilan muammoga duch kelmoq.
words.example1: The company fell foul of new data protection rules.
words.example1Translation: Kompaniya yangi ma'lumotlarni himoya qilish qoidalarini buzdi.
words.example2: The firm broke the regulations on handling personal data.
words.example2Translation: Firma shaxsiy ma'lumotlar bilan ishlash qoidalarini buzdi.
words.example3: Several journalists have fallen foul of the government.
words.example3Translation: Bir qancha jurnalistlar hukumat bilan muammoga duch kelgan.

words.definition: To confirm that an earlier court decision was correct. (IELTS ≈ confirm a decision · support a ruling · sustain a judgement)
words.definitionUz: uphold a verdict — avvalgi sud qarori to'g'ri ekanini tasdiqlamoq.
words.example1: The appeal court upheld the verdict.
words.example1Translation: Apellyatsiya sudi hukmni o'z kuchida qoldirdi.
words.example2: The higher court agreed with the original decision.
words.example2Translation: Yuqori sud dastlabki qarorga qo'shildi.
words.example3: Judges voted to uphold the verdict against the company.
words.example3Translation: Sudyalar kompaniyaga qarshi hukmni o'z kuchida qoldirishga ovoz berishdi.

words.definition: The study and theory of law. (IELTS ≈ legal theory · philosophy of law · legal science)
words.definitionUz: jurisprudence — huquqni o'rganish va uning nazariyasi.
words.example1: She studied jurisprudence at Oxford.
words.example1Translation: U Oksfordda huquqshunoslikni o'rgangan.
words.example2: She researched legal theory at university.
words.example2Translation: U universitetda huquq nazariyasini o'rgangan.
words.example3: Islamic jurisprudence has a long history.
words.example3Translation: Islom huquqshunosligi uzoq tarixga ega.

words.definition: Required or fixed by law. (IELTS ≈ legal · mandatory · official · regulatory)
words.definitionUz: statutory — qonun bilan talab qilingan yoki belgilangan.
words.example1: Employers must provide statutory sick pay.
words.example1Translation: Ish beruvchilar qonun bilan belgilangan kasallik nafaqasini to'lashi shart.
words.example2: By law, companies have to pay workers when they are ill.
words.example2Translation: Qonunga ko'ra, kompaniyalar ishchilar kasal bo'lganda haq to'lashi kerak.
words.example3: There is a statutory limit on working hours.
words.example3Translation: Ish vaqtiga qonun bilan belgilangan cheklov bor.

words.definition: The settling of a dispute by an independent person instead of a court. (IELTS ≈ mediation · settlement by a third party · adjudication)
words.definitionUz: arbitration — nizoni sud o'rniga mustaqil shaxs orqali hal qilish.
words.example1: The two companies agreed to settle the dispute through arbitration.
words.example1Translation: Ikki kompaniya nizoni arbitraj orqali hal qilishga kelishdi.
words.example2: An independent expert, not a judge, will decide the disagreement.
words.example2Translation: Kelishmovchilikni sudya emas, mustaqil mutaxassis hal qiladi.
words.example3: Arbitration is often faster than going to court.
words.example3Translation: Arbitraj ko'pincha sudga borishdan tezroq.

words.definition: An official penalty, especially one placed on a country. (IELTS ≈ penalty · restriction · embargo · punishment)
words.definitionUz: sanction — rasmiy jazo, ayniqsa mamlakatga qo'yilgan.
words.example1: Economic sanctions were imposed on the country.
words.example1Translation: Mamlakatga iqtisodiy sanksiyalar qo'yildi.
words.example2: Other nations limited trade with the country as a punishment.
words.example2Translation: Boshqa davlatlar jazo sifatida u bilan savdoni chekladi.
words.example3: Sanctions can hurt ordinary citizens more than leaders.
words.example3Translation: Sanksiyalar rahbarlardan ko'ra oddiy fuqarolarga ko'proq zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

words.definition: An official order given by a person in authority. (IELTS ≈ decree · order · command · proclamation)
words.definitionUz: edict — hokimiyatdagi shaxs tomonidan berilgan rasmiy buyruq.
words.example1: The emperor issued an edict banning foreign trade.
words.example1Translation: Imperator tashqi savdoni taqiqlovchi farmon chiqardi.
words.example2: The ruler officially ordered an end to trade with other countries.
words.example2Translation: Hukmdor boshqa mamlakatlar bilan savdoni to'xtatishni rasman buyurdi.
words.example3: Few people obeyed the edict.
words.example3Translation: Farmonga kam odam bo'ysundi.

words.definition: To announce a new law officially or spread an idea widely. (IELTS ≈ proclaim · announce · publish · spread)
words.definitionUz: promulgate — yangi qonunni rasman e'lon qilmoq yoki g'oyani keng tarqatmoq.
words.example1: The new constitution was promulgated in 1992.
words.example1Translation: Yangi konstitutsiya 1992-yilda e'lon qilingan.
words.example2: The new constitution officially came into force in 1992.
words.example2Translation: Yangi konstitutsiya 1992-yilda rasman kuchga kirgan.
words.example3: The group promulgated its ideas through pamphlets.
words.example3Translation: Guruh o'z g'oyalarini risolalar orqali tarqatdi.

words.definition: To openly break rules without trying to hide it. (IELTS ≈ break rules openly · disregard regulations · defy the rules)
words.definitionUz: flout regulations — qoidalarni yashirmasdan ochiq buzmoq.
words.example1: Some factories flout regulations on waste disposal.
words.example1Translation: Ba'zi zavodlar chiqindilarni yo'q qilish qoidalarini ochiqdan-ochiq buzadi.
words.example2: Certain factories openly ignore the rules about getting rid of waste.
words.example2Translation: Ayrim zavodlar chiqindilardan qutulish qoidalarini ochiq e'tiborsiz qoldiradi.
words.example3: Drivers who flout regulations face heavy fines.
words.example3Translation: Qoidalarni ochiq buzgan haydovchilar katta jarimaga tortiladi.

words.definition: Something that is generally used even though it has not been officially approved. (IELTS ≈ an unofficial norm · the accepted standard in practice)
words.definitionUz: a de facto standard — rasman tasdiqlanmagan bo'lsa ham, umuman qo'llanadigan narsa.
words.example1: English has become a de facto standard in international business.
words.example1Translation: Ingliz tili xalqaro biznesda amalda qabul qilingan standartga aylandi.
words.example2: Nobody made it official, but English is what everyone uses.
words.example2Translation: Uni hech kim rasmiylashtirmagan, lekin hamma ingliz tilidan foydalanadi.
words.example3: The file format became a de facto standard.
words.example3Translation: Bu fayl formati amalda qabul qilingan standartga aylandi.

words.definition: To be decided by a particular person according to their judgement. (IELTS ≈ be up to · be decided by · be at the will of)
words.definitionUz: be at the discretion of — ma'lum shaxsning o'z mulohazasiga ko'ra hal qilinmoq.
words.example1: Refunds are at the discretion of the manager.
words.example1Translation: Pulni qaytarish menejerning ixtiyorida.
words.example2: The manager decides whether customers get their money back.
words.example2Translation: Mijozlarga pul qaytarilishini menejer hal qiladi.
words.example3: Extra leave is at the discretion of the company.
words.example3Translation: Qo'shimcha ta'til kompaniyaning ixtiyorida.

words.word: the interplay of light and shadow
words.definition: The way light and dark areas work together to create effects. (IELTS ≈ contrast of light and dark · effects of light and shade)
words.definitionUz: the interplay of light and shadow — yorug' va qorong'i joylarning birgalikda effekt yaratishi.
words.example1: The architect used the interplay of light and shadow to create drama.
words.example1Translation: Me'mor ta'sirchanlik yaratish uchun yorug'lik va soya o'yinidan foydalandi.
words.example2: Patterns of light and dark make the building look dramatic.
words.example2Translation: Yorug'lik va qorong'ilik naqshlari binoni ta'sirli ko'rsatadi.
words.example3: The painting is admired for its interplay of light and shadow.
words.example3Translation: Rasm yorug'lik va soya o'yini uchun qadrlanadi.

words.definition: A style of architecture using raw concrete and heavy, simple shapes. (IELTS ≈ raw concrete style · stark modernism)
words.definitionUz: a brutalist aesthetic — xom beton va og'ir, oddiy shakllardan foydalanadigan me'moriy uslub.
words.example1: The library has a brutalist aesthetic that divides opinion.
words.example1Translation: Kutubxonaning brutalistik uslubi turli fikrlarga sabab bo'ladi.
words.example2: Some people love the plain concrete building and others hate it.
words.example2Translation: Ba'zilar oddiy beton binoni yaxshi ko'radi, boshqalar esa yomon ko'radi.
words.example3: Many post-war buildings share a brutalist aesthetic.
words.example3Translation: Urushdan keyingi ko'plab binolar brutalistik uslubga ega.

words.definition: A structure that sticks out horizontally and is supported at only one end. (IELTS ≈ an overhanging structure · a projecting beam)
words.definitionUz: a cantilevered structure — faqat bir uchidan tayanib, gorizontal chiqib turadigan inshoot.
words.example1: The house includes a cantilevered structure over the river.
words.example1Translation: Uyda daryo ustiga chiqib turgan konsolli inshoot bor.
words.example2: Part of the house hangs over the water without supports below.
words.example2Translation: Uyning bir qismi ostida tayanchlarsiz suv ustida osilib turadi.
words.example3: Engineers calculated the loads on the cantilevered structure.
words.example3Translation: Muhandislar konsolli inshootga tushadigan yuklamalarni hisoblashdi.

words.definition: Art designed to last only a short time. (IELTS ≈ temporary art · short-lived artwork)
words.definitionUz: ephemeral art — faqat qisqa vaqt saqlanadigan qilib yaratilgan san'at.
words.example1: Sand sculptures are a form of ephemeral art.
words.example1Translation: Qum haykallari o'tkinchi san'atning bir shaklidir.
words.example2: The sculptures are washed away by the sea within days.
words.example2Translation: Haykallar bir necha kun ichida dengiz tomonidan yuvilib ketadi.
words.example3: Photographs are the only record of much ephemeral art.
words.example3Translation: Ko'plab o'tkinchi san'at asarlarining yagona qaydi fotosuratlardir.

words.definition: Delicate decorative work made of fine wire or detailed patterns. (IELTS ≈ delicate metalwork · lace-like decoration)
words.definitionUz: ornamental filigree — ingichka sim yoki nozik naqshlardan yasalgan bezak ishi.
words.example1: The silver box is covered in ornamental filigree.
words.example1Translation: Kumush quti naqshinkor filigran bilan qoplangan.
words.example2: The box is decorated with very fine wire patterns.
words.example2Translation: Quti juda nozik sim naqshlar bilan bezatilgan.
words.example3: Ornamental filigree requires great patience to produce.
words.example3Translation: Naqshinkor filigran yasash katta sabr talab qiladi.

words.definition: The most important work of an artist or writer. (IELTS ≈ a masterpiece · a greatest work · a crowning achievement)
words.definitionUz: a magnum opus — rassom yoki yozuvchining eng muhim asari.
words.example1: The novel is widely considered her magnum opus.
words.example1Translation: Roman keng tarzda uning eng buyuk asari hisoblanadi.
words.example2: Most critics see this book as her greatest achievement.
words.example2Translation: Ko'pchilik tanqidchilar bu kitobni uning eng katta yutug'i deb biladi.
words.example3: He spent twenty years on his magnum opus.
words.example3Translation: U eng buyuk asariga yigirma yil sarfladi.

words.definition: An extremely impressive achievement showing great skill. (IELTS ≈ a masterpiece · a brilliant performance · a triumph)
words.definitionUz: a tour de force — katta mahoratni ko'rsatadigan nihoyatda ta'sirli yutuq.
words.example1: Her performance in the film was a tour de force.
words.example1Translation: Uning filmdagi ijrosi mahorat cho'qqisi edi.
words.example2: She acted with outstanding skill.
words.example2Translation: U ajoyib mahorat bilan o'ynadi.
words.example3: The bridge is a tour de force of engineering.
words.example3Translation: Ko'prik muhandislik mahoratining cho'qqisidir.

words.definition: A varied combination of things from many different sources. (IELTS ≈ a diverse mixture of · a wide-ranging blend of)
words.definitionUz: an eclectic mix of — turli manbalardan olingan narsalarning xilma-xil birikmasi.
words.example1: The café has an eclectic mix of furniture.
words.example1Translation: Qahvaxonada rang-barang mebellar aralashmasi bor.
words.example2: The furniture comes from many different styles and periods.
words.example2Translation: Mebellar turli uslub va davrlarga tegishli.
words.example3: The festival features an eclectic mix of music.
words.example3Translation: Festivalda turli xil musiqalarning rang-barang aralashmasi bor.

words.definition: A work that imitates and combines several earlier styles. (IELTS ≈ an imitation of styles · a stylistic medley)
words.definitionUz: a pastiche of styles — bir nechta avvalgi uslublarga taqlid qilib, ularni birlashtirgan asar.
words.example1: The building is a pastiche of styles from different centuries.
words.example1Translation: Bino turli asrlar uslublarining taqlidi aralashmasi.
words.example2: It copies features from several historical periods.
words.example2Translation: U bir nechta tarixiy davrlarning xususiyatlarini takrorlaydi.
words.example3: Critics dismissed the film as a pastiche of styles.
words.example3Translation: Tanqidchilar filmni uslublar taqlidi aralashmasi deb rad etishdi.

words.definition: To show the mood and ideas typical of a particular time. (IELTS ≈ reflect the spirit of the age · express the mood of the times)
words.definitionUz: capture the zeitgeist — ma'lum davrga xos kayfiyat va g'oyalarni ko'rsatmoq.
words.example1: The novel captures the zeitgeist of the 1960s.
words.example1Translation: Roman 1960-yillar davri ruhini aks ettiradi.
words.example2: The book shows how people thought and felt in that decade.
words.example2Translation: Kitob o'sha o'n yillikda odamlar qanday o'ylagan va his qilganini ko'rsatadi.
words.example3: Few artists capture the zeitgeist as well as she does.
words.example3Translation: Kam rassomlar davr ruhini u kabi yaxshi aks ettiradi.

words.definition: The way a space or material affects sound. (IELTS ≈ the sound quality of · how sound behaves in)
words.definitionUz: the acoustic properties of — bo'shliq yoki material tovushga qanday ta'sir qilishi.
words.example1: The acoustic properties of the hall are excellent.
words.example1Translation: Zalning akustik xususiyatlari a'lo darajada.
words.example2: Music sounds very clear in this hall.
words.example2Translation: Bu zalda musiqa juda aniq eshitiladi.
words.example3: Engineers tested the acoustic properties of the new materials.
words.example3Translation: Muhandislar yangi materiallarning akustik xususiyatlarini sinab ko'rishdi.

words.definition: The idea that art should be valued for its beauty, not for any moral or practical purpose. (IELTS ≈ aestheticism · art without a message)
words.definitionUz: art for art's sake — san'at axloqiy yoki amaliy maqsad uchun emas, go'zalligi uchun qadrlanishi kerak degan g'oya.
words.example1: The poet believed in art for art's sake.
words.example1Translation: Shoir "san'at san'at uchun" g'oyasiga ishongan.
words.example2: He thought poems did not need to teach lessons.
words.example2Translation: U she'rlar saboq berishi shart emas deb o'ylagan.
words.example3: Critics rejected art for art's sake as self-indulgent.
words.example3Translation: Tanqidchilar "san'at san'at uchun" g'oyasini xudbinlik deb rad etishdi.

words.definition: A typical feature that identifies something. (IELTS ≈ a characteristic of · a typical feature of · a mark of)
words.definitionUz: a hallmark of — biror narsani aniqlaydigan tipik xususiyat.
words.example1: Blue tiles are a hallmark of Timurid architecture.
words.example1Translation: Moviy koshinlar Temuriylar me'morchiligining o'ziga xos belgisi.
words.example2: You can recognise Timurid buildings by their blue tiles.
words.example2Translation: Temuriy binolarni moviy koshinlaridan tanib olish mumkin.
words.example3: Attention to detail is a hallmark of her work.
words.example3Translation: Tafsilotlarga e'tibor uning ishining o'ziga xos belgisi.

words.definition: The images and symbols used in a particular kind of art. (IELTS ≈ symbolism · imagery · visual symbols)
words.definitionUz: iconography — ma'lum turdagi san'atda ishlatiladigan tasvir va ramzlar.
words.example1: The iconography of the paintings reflects Buddhist beliefs.
words.example1Translation: Rasmlarning ramziy tasvirlari buddaviy e'tiqodlarni aks ettiradi.
words.example2: The symbols in the pictures come from Buddhist religion.
words.example2Translation: Rasmlardagi ramzlar buddizm dinidan olingan.
words.example3: Scholars study the iconography of ancient coins.
words.example3Translation: Olimlar qadimiy tangalardagi ramziy tasvirlarni o'rganadi.

words.definition: Covered with a thin layer of gold. (IELTS ≈ gold-plated · golden · gilt · decorated with gold)
words.definitionUz: gilded — yupqa oltin qatlami bilan qoplangan.
words.example1: The palace ceilings are gilded and painted.
words.example1Translation: Saroy shiftlari zarhallangan va bo'yalgan.
words.example2: The ceilings are decorated with gold and paint.
words.example2Translation: Shiftlar oltin va bo'yoq bilan bezatilgan.
words.example3: The book has gilded edges.
words.example3Translation: Kitobning chetlari zarhallangan.

words.definition: In a highly decorated European style of the 17th–18th centuries, or very complicated. (IELTS ≈ ornate · elaborate · extravagant · highly decorated)
words.definitionUz: baroque — XVII–XVIII asrlarning juda bezakli Yevropa uslubida yoki juda murakkab.
words.example1: The church is a fine example of baroque architecture.
words.example1Translation: Cherkov barokko me'morchiligining ajoyib namunasidir.
words.example2: The building is full of rich and dramatic decoration.
words.example2Translation: Bino boy va ta'sirli bezaklarga to'la.
words.example3: The tax system has become baroque in its complexity.
words.example3Translation: Soliq tizimi haddan tashqari murakkablashib ketdi.

words.definition: Art or objects considered cheap, sentimental and in poor taste. (IELTS ≈ tasteless art · tacky decoration · cheap sentimentality)
words.definitionUz: kitsch — arzon, his-tuyg'uga berilgan va didsiz deb hisoblangan san'at yoki buyumlar.
words.example1: The souvenir shop is full of kitsch.
words.example1Translation: Suvenir do'koni didsiz bezaklarga to'la.
words.example2: The shop sells cheap and tasteless decorations.
words.example2Translation: Do'konda arzon va didsiz bezaklar sotiladi.
words.example3: Some artists deliberately use kitsch to make a point.
words.example3Translation: Ba'zi rassomlar fikrini bildirish uchun ataylab kichdan foydalanadi.

words.definition: To suit or match the style of something. (IELTS ≈ match · suit · be consistent with · harmonise with)
words.definitionUz: be in keeping with — biror narsaning uslubiga mos kelmoq.
words.example1: The new building is in keeping with the old town.
words.example1Translation: Yangi bino eski shaharga mos.
words.example2: It matches the style of the historic buildings around it.
words.example2Translation: U atrofidagi tarixiy binolar uslubiga mos keladi.
words.example3: His behaviour was not in keeping with his position.
words.example3Translation: Uning xatti-harakati lavozimiga mos emas edi.

words.definition: Farming methods that work with natural ecosystems. (IELTS ≈ nature-based farming · ecological agriculture)
words.definitionUz: agroecological practices — tabiiy ekotizimlar bilan hamohang ishlaydigan dehqonchilik usullari.
words.example1: Agroecological practices reduce the need for chemicals.
words.example1Translation: Agroekologik amaliyotlar kimyoviy moddalarga ehtiyojni kamaytiradi.
words.example2: Farming in harmony with nature needs fewer pesticides.
words.example2Translation: Tabiat bilan uyg'un dehqonchilik kamroq pestitsid talab qiladi.
words.example3: The project trains farmers in agroecological practices.
words.example3Translation: Loyiha fermerlarni agroekologik amaliyotlarga o'rgatadi.

words.definition: Planning farms and gardens to be self-sustaining like natural ecosystems. (IELTS ≈ sustainable garden design · self-sustaining agriculture)
words.definitionUz: permaculture design — ferma va bog'larni tabiiy ekotizimlar kabi o'zini o'zi ta'minlaydigan qilib rejalashtirish.
words.example1: Permaculture design uses plants that support each other.
words.example1Translation: Permakultura dizayni bir-birini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan o'simliklardan foydalanadi.
words.example2: The garden is planned so that plants help one another grow.
words.example2Translation: Bog' o'simliklar bir-birining o'sishiga yordam beradigan qilib rejalashtirilgan.
words.example3: She took a course in permaculture design.
words.example3Translation: U permakultura dizayni bo'yicha kurs o'tdi.

words.definition: Storing seeds to protect plant varieties for the future. (IELTS ≈ seed storage · conservation of plant varieties)
words.definitionUz: seed bank preservation — o'simlik navlarini kelajak uchun himoya qilish maqsadida urug'larni saqlash.
words.example1: Seed bank preservation protects crops from extinction.
words.example1Translation: Urug' bankida saqlash ekinlarni yo'qolib ketishdan himoya qiladi.
words.example2: Storing seeds means plant types can be grown again if lost.
words.example2Translation: Urug'larni saqlash o'simlik turlari yo'qolsa, ularni qayta yetishtirish mumkinligini anglatadi.
words.example3: The vault in Norway is famous for seed bank preservation.
words.example3Translation: Norvegiyadagi omborxona urug' saqlash bilan mashhur.

words.definition: Adding vitamins and minerals to food to improve nutrition. (IELTS ≈ adding vitamins to food · food enrichment)
words.definitionUz: micronutrient fortification — ovqatlanishni yaxshilash uchun oziq-ovqatga vitamin va minerallar qo'shish.
words.example1: Micronutrient fortification of flour has reduced anaemia.
words.example1Translation: Unni mikroelementlar bilan boyitish kamqonlikni kamaytirdi.
words.example2: Adding iron to flour has made fewer people anaemic.
words.example2Translation: Unga temir qo'shish kamqonlikdan aziyat chekuvchilarni kamaytirdi.
words.example3: Salt is a common target for micronutrient fortification.
words.example3Translation: Tuz ko'pincha mikroelementlar bilan boyitiladi.

words.definition: The decline in quality of land used for growing crops. (IELTS ≈ soil degradation · loss of fertile land)
words.definitionUz: arable land degradation — ekin yetishtirish uchun ishlatiladigan yer sifatining pasayishi.
words.example1: Arable land degradation threatens food security.
words.example1Translation: Ekin yerlarining yaroqsizlanishi oziq-ovqat xavfsizligiga tahdid soladi.
words.example2: As farmland gets poorer, less food can be grown.
words.example2Translation: Ekin yerlari kambag'allashgani sari kamroq oziq-ovqat yetishtirish mumkin bo'ladi.
words.example3: Overuse of chemicals contributes to arable land degradation.
words.example3Translation: Kimyoviy moddalardan haddan tashqari foydalanish ekin yerlarining yaroqsizlanishiga hissa qo'shadi.

words.definition: The danger that a single crop can be destroyed by one disease or pest. (IELTS ≈ single-crop risk · lack of crop diversity)
words.definitionUz: monoculture vulnerability — bitta ekin bitta kasallik yoki zararkunanda tomonidan yo'q qilinishi xavfi.
words.example1: The Irish potato famine showed the dangers of monoculture vulnerability.
words.example1Translation: Irlandiyadagi kartoshka ocharchiligi monokultura zaifligi xavfini ko'rsatdi.
words.example2: When everyone grew one kind of potato, a single disease destroyed it.
words.example2Translation: Hamma bir xil kartoshka ekkanda, bitta kasallik uni yo'q qildi.
words.example3: Planting several varieties reduces monoculture vulnerability.
words.example3Translation: Bir necha nav ekish monokultura zaifligini kamaytiradi.

words.definition: An unusually large harvest. (IELTS ≈ a record crop · an abundant harvest · a plentiful yield)
words.definitionUz: a bumper harvest — g'ayrioddiy darajada katta hosil.
words.example1: Good rains led to a bumper harvest this year.
words.example1Translation: Yaxshi yomg'irlar bu yil mo'l hosilga olib keldi.
words.example2: Farmers collected far more crops than usual.
words.example2Translation: Fermerlar odatdagidan ancha ko'p hosil yig'ishdi.
words.example3: A bumper harvest pushed down grain prices.
words.example3Translation: Mo'l hosil don narxlarini tushirdi.

words.definition: Clearing forest by cutting and burning trees to create farmland. (IELTS ≈ clearing forest by fire · shifting cultivation)
words.definitionUz: slash-and-burn agriculture — ekin yeri yaratish uchun daraxtlarni kesib yoqish orqali o'rmonni tozalash.
words.example1: Slash-and-burn agriculture is destroying parts of the rainforest.
words.example1Translation: Kesib-yoqib dehqonchilik tropik o'rmonning bir qismini yo'q qilmoqda.
words.example2: Farmers cut and burn trees to make new fields.
words.example2Translation: Fermerlar yangi dalalar ochish uchun daraxtlarni kesib yoqadi.
words.example3: Slash-and-burn agriculture quickly exhausts the soil.
words.example3Translation: Kesib-yoqib dehqonchilik tuproqni tez holdan toydiradi.

words.definition: Flat steps cut into hillsides for growing crops. (IELTS ≈ stepped fields · hillside terraces)
words.definitionUz: terraced fields — ekin yetishtirish uchun tepalik yonbag'riga o'yilgan tekis zinalar.
words.example1: The terraced fields of Bali are a UNESCO site.
words.example1Translation: Balidagi zinapoyasimon dalalar YUNESKO ro'yxatiga kiritilgan.
words.example2: Rice is grown on steps cut into the hills.
words.example2Translation: Guruch tepaliklarga o'yilgan zinalarda yetishtiriladi.
words.example3: Terraced fields help to prevent soil erosion.
words.example3Translation: Zinapoyasimon dalalar tuproq eroziyasining oldini olishga yordam beradi.

words.definition: The period from the 1950s when new crop varieties and chemicals greatly increased food production. (IELTS ≈ the agricultural boom of the 1960s · modern farming revolution)
words.definitionUz: the Green Revolution — 1950-yillardan boshlab yangi ekin navlari va kimyoviy moddalar oziq-ovqat ishlab chiqarishni keskin oshirgan davr.
words.example1: The Green Revolution saved millions from hunger.
words.example1Translation: "Yashil inqilob" millionlab odamlarni ochlikdan qutqardi.
words.example2: New seeds and fertilisers greatly increased harvests in Asia.
words.example2Translation: Yangi urug'lar va o'g'itlar Osiyoda hosilni keskin oshirdi.
words.example3: Critics say the Green Revolution harmed the environment.
words.example3Translation: Tanqidchilar "Yashil inqilob" atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazdi deyishadi.

words.definition: An area suffering from a serious lack of food. (IELTS ≈ an area hit by famine · a starving region)
words.definitionUz: a famine-stricken region — jiddiy oziq-ovqat tanqisligidan aziyat chekayotgan hudud.
words.example1: Aid was flown into the famine-stricken region.
words.example1Translation: Ocharchilikka uchragan hududga yordam havo orqali yetkazildi.
words.example2: Food supplies were sent by plane to people who were starving.
words.example2Translation: Och qolgan odamlarga oziq-ovqat samolyotda yuborildi.
words.example3: Drought turned the area into a famine-stricken region.
words.example3Translation: Qurg'oqchilik hududni ocharchilikka uchratdi.

words.definition: The right of a people to control their own food and farming systems. (IELTS ≈ control over local food systems · food self-determination)
words.definitionUz: food sovereignty — xalqning o'z oziq-ovqat va dehqonchilik tizimini nazorat qilish huquqi.
words.example1: Small farmers campaign for food sovereignty.
words.example1Translation: Kichik fermerlar oziq-ovqat suvereniteti uchun kurashadi.
words.example2: They want local communities to decide how food is produced.
words.example2Translation: Ular oziq-ovqat qanday ishlab chiqarilishini mahalliy jamoalar hal qilishini xohlaydi.
words.example3: Food sovereignty is a key issue in trade negotiations.
words.example3Translation: Oziq-ovqat suvereniteti savdo muzokaralarida asosiy masala.

words.definition: A basic food that people eat regularly. (IELTS ≈ a basic food · a dietary mainstay · a main food)
words.definitionUz: a staple of the diet — odamlar muntazam iste'mol qiladigan asosiy oziq-ovqat.
words.example1: Bread is a staple of the diet in Uzbekistan.
words.example1Translation: Non O'zbekistonda ratsionning asosiy qismi.
words.example2: Almost every meal in Uzbekistan includes bread.
words.example2Translation: O'zbekistonda deyarli har bir taomga non qo'shiladi.
words.example3: Maize is a staple of the diet in much of Africa.
words.example3Translation: Makkajo'xori Afrikaning ko'p qismida ratsionning asosiy qismi.

words.definition: The growing of fruit, vegetables and flowers. (IELTS ≈ gardening · fruit and vegetable growing · cultivation)
words.definitionUz: horticulture — meva, sabzavot va gullar yetishtirish.
words.example1: The region's economy depends on horticulture.
words.example1Translation: Mintaqa iqtisodiyoti bog'dorchilikka bog'liq.
words.example2: Growing fruit and vegetables is the area's main industry.
words.example2Translation: Meva va sabzavot yetishtirish hududning asosiy sohasi.
words.example3: She studied horticulture at college.
words.example3Translation: U kollejda bog'dorchilikni o'rgangan.

words.definition: Farming and food production run as large commercial businesses. (IELTS ≈ industrial farming · commercial agriculture · agro-industry)
words.definitionUz: agribusiness — yirik tijorat biznesi sifatida yuritiladigan dehqonchilik va oziq-ovqat ishlab chiqarish.
words.example1: Agribusiness now dominates food production.
words.example1Translation: Agrobiznes endi oziq-ovqat ishlab chiqarishda hukmron.
words.example2: Large companies control most of the food we eat.
words.example2Translation: Yirik kompaniyalar biz iste'mol qiladigan oziq-ovqatning ko'p qismini nazorat qiladi.
words.example3: Small farmers struggle to compete with agribusiness.
words.example3Translation: Kichik fermerlarga agrobiznes bilan raqobatlashish qiyin.

words.definition: A farmer who owns or rents a small piece of land. (IELTS ≈ small-scale farmer · peasant farmer · family farmer)
words.definitionUz: smallholder — kichik yer uchastkasiga egalik qiladigan yoki ijaraga olgan dehqon.
words.example1: Smallholders produce much of the world's food.
words.example1Translation: Kichik yer egalari dunyo oziq-ovqatining katta qismini ishlab chiqaradi.
words.example2: Farmers with small plots grow a large share of food.
words.example2Translation: Kichik uchastkali dehqonlar oziq-ovqatning katta qismini yetishtiradi.
words.example3: The scheme gives loans to smallholders.
words.example3Translation: Dastur kichik yer egalariga qarz beradi.

words.definition: A building where grain is stored. (IELTS ≈ grain store · silo · storehouse)
words.definitionUz: granary — don saqlanadigan bino.
words.example1: The ancient granary could store grain for a whole city.
words.example1Translation: Qadimiy don ombori butun shahar uchun don saqlay olgan.
words.example2: The old storehouse held enough grain to feed everyone.
words.example2Translation: Eski omborda hammani boqishga yetadigan don saqlangan.
words.example3: Ukraine was once called the granary of Europe.
words.example3Translation: Ukraina bir vaqtlar Yevropaning don ombori deb atalgan.

words.definition: To search widely for food. (IELTS ≈ search for food · hunt for · scavenge · gather)
words.definitionUz: forage — oziq-ovqat izlab keng qidirmoq.
words.example1: Bees forage over several kilometres.
words.example1Translation: Asalarilar bir necha kilometr masofada oziq izlaydi.
words.example2: Bees travel long distances looking for flowers.
words.example2Translation: Asalarilar gul izlab uzoq masofalarga uchadi.
words.example3: Early humans foraged for berries and roots.
words.example3Translation: Ilk odamlar rezavorlar va ildizlar izlab yurishgan.

words.definition: A disease that damages plants, or something that spoils or damages. (IELTS ≈ plant disease · fungus · scourge · curse)
words.definitionUz: blight — o'simliklarga zarar yetkazadigan kasallik yoki biror narsani buzadigan narsa.
words.example1: Potato blight caused the Irish famine.
words.example1Translation: Kartoshka kasalligi Irlandiya ocharchiligiga sabab bo'ldi.
words.example2: A plant disease destroyed the potato crop.
words.example2Translation: O'simlik kasalligi kartoshka hosilini yo'q qildi.
words.example3: Litter is a blight on the city's parks.
words.example3Translation: Chiqindilar shahar bog'lari uchun ofatdir.

words.definition: A situation that will become a serious problem in the future if nothing is done. (IELTS ≈ a looming disaster · a hidden danger · a crisis waiting to happen)
words.definitionUz: a ticking time bomb — hech narsa qilinmasa, kelajakda jiddiy muammoga aylanadigan vaziyat.
words.example1: Rising obesity is a ticking time bomb for health services.
words.example1Translation: Semizlikning ortishi sog'liqni saqlash tizimi uchun portlashga tayyor bombadir.
words.example2: Unless action is taken, obesity will overwhelm hospitals.
words.example2Translation: Chora ko'rilmasa, semizlik shifoxonalarni to'ldirib yuboradi.
words.example3: The pension system is a ticking time bomb.
words.example3Translation: Pensiya tizimi yashirin xavf manbaidir.

words.definition: A situation in which several bad things happen at the same time and make things very bad. (IELTS ≈ a combination of disasters · a worst-case combination)
words.definitionUz: a perfect storm — bir nechta yomon narsa bir vaqtda sodir bo'lib, vaziyatni juda yomonlashtirishi.
words.example1: Drought, war and high prices created a perfect storm.
words.example1Translation: Qurg'oqchilik, urush va yuqori narxlar barcha yomon omillarning birlashuvini yuzaga keltirdi.
words.example2: Several problems arrived at once and caused a severe crisis.
words.example2Translation: Bir nechta muammo bir vaqtda kelib, og'ir inqirozga sabab bo'ldi.
words.example3: The company faced a perfect storm of falling sales and rising costs.
words.example3Translation: Kompaniya savdo pasayishi va xarajatlar oshishining bir vaqtda kelishiga duch keldi.

days.topic: Xavf va inqiroz · Baholash va qamrov

words.definition: A situation in which one event causes a series of similar events. (IELTS ≈ a chain reaction · a ripple effect · a knock-on effect)
words.definitionUz: a domino effect — bitta voqea bir qator o'xshash voqealarga sabab bo'ladigan vaziyat.
words.example1: The failure of one bank caused a domino effect across the system.
words.example1Translation: Bitta bankning barbod bo'lishi butun tizimda domino effektiga sabab bo'ldi.
words.example2: When one bank failed, others quickly followed.
words.example2Translation: Bitta bank barbod bo'lgach, boshqalari ham tezda ergashdi.
words.example3: Experts fear a domino effect if one country leaves the union.
words.example3Translation: Mutaxassislar bitta davlat ittifoqni tark etsa, domino effekti bo'lishidan qo'rqishadi.

words.definition: To be in a very dangerous or uncertain situation. (IELTS ≈ be in great danger · be very precarious · be close to failure)
words.definitionUz: hang by a thread — juda xavfli yoki noaniq vaziyatda bo'lmoq.
words.example1: After the accident, his life hung by a thread.
words.example1Translation: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin uning hayoti qil ustida turdi.
words.example2: He was very close to dying after the accident.
words.example2Translation: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin u o'limga juda yaqin edi.
words.example3: The peace agreement is hanging by a thread.
words.example3Translation: Tinchlik kelishuvi qil ustida turibdi.

words.definition: Managing dangers before they happen rather than reacting afterwards. (IELTS ≈ forward-looking risk management · preventive planning)
words.definitionUz: proactive risk governance — xavflarni yuz bergandan keyin emas, oldindan boshqarish.
words.example1: Proactive risk governance could have prevented the disaster.
words.example1Translation: Faol xavf boshqaruvi falokatning oldini olishi mumkin edi.
words.example2: Planning for risks in advance would have stopped the disaster.
words.example2Translation: Xavflarni oldindan rejalashtirish falokatni to'xtatgan bo'lardi.
words.example3: Insurers reward companies for proactive risk governance.
words.example3Translation: Sug'urtachilar kompaniyalarni faol xavf boshqaruvi uchun rag'batlantiradi.

words.definition: A situation in which an accident almost happened. (IELTS ≈ a close call · a narrow escape · a lucky escape)
words.definitionUz: a near miss — baxtsiz hodisa sodir bo'lishiga oz qolgan vaziyat.
words.example1: Two planes had a near miss over the airport.
words.example1Translation: Ikki samolyot aeroport ustida zo'rg'a to'qnashuvdan qochdi.
words.example2: The aircraft very nearly crashed into each other.
words.example2Translation: Samolyotlar bir-biriga to'qnashishiga juda oz qoldi.
words.example3: Every near miss should be reported and investigated.
words.example3Translation: Har bir zo'rg'a oldi olingan hodisa haqida xabar berilishi va tekshirilishi kerak.

words.definition: Actions to reduce the harm caused by a bad situation. (IELTS ≈ limiting the harm · minimising losses · containing damage)
words.definitionUz: damage limitation — yomon vaziyat keltirgan zararni kamaytirish choralari.
words.example1: The company is now focused on damage limitation.
words.example1Translation: Kompaniya endi zararni cheklashga e'tibor qaratmoqda.
words.example2: The firm is trying to reduce the harm caused by the scandal.
words.example2Translation: Firma janjal keltirgan zararni kamaytirishga harakat qilmoqda.
words.example3: The minister's apology was an exercise in damage limitation.
words.example3Translation: Vazirning kechirim so'rashi zararni cheklashga urinish edi.

words.definition: A serious problem that is about to happen. (IELTS ≈ an approaching crisis · an impending emergency)
words.definitionUz: a looming crisis — yuz berish arafasidagi jiddiy muammo.
words.example1: Experts warn of a looming crisis in water supply.
words.example1Translation: Mutaxassislar suv ta'minotidagi yaqinlashib kelayotgan inqirozdan ogohlantirmoqda.
words.example2: A serious water shortage will soon arrive unless action is taken.
words.example2Translation: Chora ko'rilmasa, tez orada jiddiy suv tanqisligi yuzaga keladi.
words.example3: The government ignored the looming crisis.
words.example3Translation: Hukumat yaqinlashib kelayotgan inqirozni e'tiborsiz qoldirdi.

words.definition: To be full of risks. (IELTS ≈ be very risky · be full of hazards · be perilous)
words.definitionUz: be fraught with danger — xavflarga to'la bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The journey across the desert was fraught with danger.
words.example1Translation: Cho'l orqali sayohat xavf-xatarga to'la edi.
words.example2: Crossing the desert involved many serious risks.
words.example2Translation: Cho'lni kesib o'tish ko'plab jiddiy xavflarni o'z ichiga olgan.
words.example3: Investing in new markets is fraught with danger.
words.example3Translation: Yangi bozorlarga sarmoya kiritish xavf-xatarga to'la.

words.definition: A risk taken after carefully considering the possible results. (IELTS ≈ a considered gamble · a deliberate risk)
words.definitionUz: a calculated risk — ehtimoliy natijalarni puxta o'ylab ko'rgandan keyin qilingan tavakkal.
words.example1: Opening a second shop was a calculated risk.
words.example1Translation: Ikkinchi do'konni ochish o'ylangan tavakkal edi.
words.example2: The owner thought carefully before taking the chance.
words.example2Translation: Egasi tavakkal qilishdan oldin yaxshilab o'ylab ko'rdi.
words.example3: Investors are willing to take a calculated risk.
words.example3Translation: Investorlar o'ylangan tavakkalga tayyor.

words.word: in the eye of the storm
words.definition: At the centre of a difficult or controversial situation. (IELTS ≈ at the centre of controversy · in the middle of a crisis)
words.definitionUz: in the eye of the storm — qiyin yoki bahsli vaziyatning markazida.
words.example1: The minister found himself in the eye of the storm.
words.example1Translation: Vazir o'zini bo'ron markazida topdi.
words.example2: The minister was at the centre of the scandal.
words.example2Translation: Vazir janjalning markazida edi.
words.example3: Nurses were in the eye of the storm during the pandemic.
words.example3Translation: Pandemiya davrida hamshiralar bo'ron markazida bo'lishdi.

words.definition: Very dangerous. (IELTS ≈ dangerous · hazardous · risky · precarious)
words.definitionUz: perilous — juda xavfli.
words.example1: Migrants made a perilous journey across the sea.
words.example1Translation: Muhojirlar dengiz orqali xatarli safarga chiqishdi.
words.example2: The trip across the sea was extremely dangerous.
words.example2Translation: Dengiz orqali safar juda xavfli edi.
words.example3: The economy is in a perilous state.
words.example3Translation: Iqtisodiyot xatarli ahvolda.

words.definition: Causing sudden and violent destruction. (IELTS ≈ catastrophic · devastating · disastrous · calamitous)
words.definitionUz: cataclysmic — to'satdan va shiddatli vayronagarchilikka sabab bo'ladigan.
words.example1: A cataclysmic eruption destroyed the ancient city.
words.example1Translation: Halokatli otilish qadimiy shaharni vayron qildi.
words.example2: A huge volcanic explosion wiped out the city.
words.example2Translation: Ulkan vulqon otilishi shaharni yer bilan yakson qildi.
words.example3: Scientists warn of cataclysmic climate change.
words.example3Translation: Olimlar halokatli iqlim o'zgarishidan ogohlantiradi.

words.definition: Not expected or predicted. (IELTS ≈ unexpected · unpredicted · unanticipated · surprise)
words.definitionUz: unforeseen — kutilmagan yoki oldindan aytilmagan.
words.example1: The project was delayed by unforeseen problems.
words.example1Translation: Loyiha kutilmagan muammolar tufayli kechikdi.
words.example2: Problems nobody had predicted slowed the project down.
words.example2Translation: Hech kim oldindan ko'rmagan muammolar loyihani sekinlashtirdi.
words.example3: Always keep money aside for unforeseen expenses.
words.example3Translation: Doimo kutilmagan xarajatlar uchun pul ajratib qo'ying.

words.definition: A feeling that something bad will happen. (IELTS ≈ sense of doom · apprehension · premonition · dread)
words.definitionUz: foreboding — yomon narsa yuz berishini oldindan his qilish.
words.example1: She was filled with foreboding as the storm approached.
words.example1Translation: Bo'ron yaqinlashgani sari u yomonlikni oldindan sezdi.
words.example2: She felt that something terrible was going to happen.
words.example2Translation: U dahshatli narsa yuz berishini his qildi.
words.example3: The novel opens with a sense of foreboding.
words.example3Translation: Roman yomonlikni oldindan sezish hissi bilan boshlanadi.

words.definition: Harmful to or tending to prevent something. (IELTS ≈ harmful to · hostile to · damaging to · detrimental to)
words.definitionUz: inimical to — biror narsaga zararli yoki unga to'sqinlik qiladigan.
words.example1: Constant noise is inimical to concentration.
words.example1Translation: Doimiy shovqin diqqatni jamlashga zararli.
words.example2: It is very hard to focus when there is always noise.
words.example2Translation: Doimo shovqin bo'lsa, diqqatni jamlash juda qiyin.
words.example3: Censorship is inimical to creativity.
words.example3Translation: Senzura ijodkorlikka dushmandir.
