words.definition: To stop something bad from happening for a while. (IELTS ≈ prevent · ward off · hold off · avert)
words.definitionUz: stave off — yomon narsaning yuz berishini bir muddat to'xtatib turmoq.
words.example1: The loan helped the company stave off bankruptcy.
words.example1Translation: Qarz kompaniyaga bankrotlikning oldini olishga yordam berdi.
words.example2: The borrowed money kept the firm from going bankrupt for now.
words.example2Translation: Olingan qarz firmani hozircha bankrot bo'lishdan saqladi.
words.example3: Exercise may help stave off memory loss.
words.example3Translation: Jismoniy mashq xotira zaiflashuvining oldini olishga yordam berishi mumkin.

words.definition: Matching something in size, amount or importance. (IELTS ≈ in proportion to · appropriate to · corresponding to · in line with)
words.definitionUz: commensurate with — o'lchami, miqdori yoki ahamiyati bo'yicha biror narsaga mos.
words.example1: Salary will be commensurate with experience.
words.example1Translation: Ish haqi tajribaga mos bo'ladi.
words.example2: People with more experience will be paid more.
words.example2Translation: Tajribasi ko'proq odamlarga ko'proq maosh to'lanadi.
words.example3: The punishment should be commensurate with the crime.
words.example3Translation: Jazo jinoyatga mos bo'lishi kerak.

words.definition: Almost the same as something, usually something bad. (IELTS ≈ equivalent to · as good as · amounting to · the same as)
words.definitionUz: tantamount to — deyarli biror narsa, odatda yomon narsa bilan bir xil.
words.example1: Ignoring the warnings was tantamount to negligence.
words.example1Translation: Ogohlantirishlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirish beparvolik bilan barobar edi.
words.example2: Not acting on the warnings was almost the same as being careless.
words.example2Translation: Ogohlantirishlarga amal qilmaslik deyarli beparvolik bilan bir xil edi.
words.example3: His silence was tantamount to an admission of guilt.
words.example3Translation: Uning jim turishi aybini tan olish bilan barobar edi.

words.definition: A small amount of something. (IELTS ≈ a little · a small amount of · a degree of · a touch of)
words.definitionUz: a modicum of — biror narsaning ozgina miqdori.
words.example1: With a modicum of effort, you could pass the exam.
words.example1Translation: Ozgina harakat bilan imtihondan o'ta olardingiz.
words.example2: Even a little work would have been enough to pass.
words.example2Translation: Hatto ozgina mehnat ham o'tish uchun yetarli bo'lardi.
words.example3: The plan shows a modicum of common sense.
words.example3Translation: Rejada bir oz sog'lom fikr ko'rinadi.

words.definition: By a very large amount, often ten times or more. (IELTS ≈ enormously · many times over · vastly)
words.definitionUz: by orders of magnitude — juda katta miqdorda, ko'pincha o'n baravar yoki undan ko'p.
words.example1: New computers are faster by orders of magnitude.
words.example1Translation: Yangi kompyuterlar ko'p marotaba tezroq.
words.example2: Today's computers are many times quicker than older ones.
words.example2Translation: Bugungi kompyuterlar eskilaridan bir necha baravar tezroq.
words.example3: The new estimate is larger by orders of magnitude.
words.example3Translation: Yangi hisob-kitob bir necha baravar kattaroq.

words.definition: The largest part of something. (IELTS ≈ the majority of · the bulk of · most of · the biggest portion of)
words.definitionUz: the lion's share of — biror narsaning eng katta qismi.
words.example1: The capital receives the lion's share of investment.
words.example1Translation: Poytaxt sarmoyaning katta qismini oladi.
words.example2: Most of the money goes to the capital city.
words.example2Translation: Pulning ko'p qismi poytaxtga ketadi.
words.example3: Rent takes the lion's share of their income.
words.example3Translation: Ijara haqi ularning daromadining katta qismini oladi.

words.definition: Better than all others. (IELTS ≈ the best · unrivalled · unmatched · unbeatable)
words.definitionUz: second to none — boshqalarning hammasidan yaxshiroq.
words.example1: The hotel's service is second to none.
words.example1Translation: Mehmonxona xizmati tengsiz.
words.example2: No other hotel offers better service.
words.example2Translation: Hech bir boshqa mehmonxona yaxshiroq xizmat ko'rsatmaydi.
words.example3: Her knowledge of the subject is second to none.
words.example3Translation: Uning bu fan bo'yicha bilimi tengsiz.

words.definition: To be much worse than it should be. (IELTS ≈ be unsatisfactory · be poor · fall short · be disappointing)
words.definitionUz: leave much to be desired — bo'lishi kerakdan ancha yomonroq bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The quality of the food left much to be desired.
words.example1Translation: Ovqat sifati ancha ko'ngildagidek emas edi.
words.example2: The food was not nearly as good as it should have been.
words.example2Translation: Ovqat bo'lishi kerakdagidek yaxshi emas edi.
words.example3: Safety standards at the factory leave much to be desired.
words.example3Translation: Zavoddagi xavfsizlik standartlari ancha past.

words.definition: Not accurate or correct. (IELTS ≈ inaccurate · incorrect · off target · mistaken)
words.definitionUz: wide of the mark — aniq yoki to'g'ri emas.
words.example1: Early predictions of the cost were wide of the mark.
words.example1Translation: Xarajat haqidagi dastlabki bashoratlar haqiqatdan uzoq edi.
words.example2: The first estimates were far from the real figure.
words.example2Translation: Dastlabki taxminlar haqiqiy raqamdan juda uzoq edi.
words.example3: His guess was not far wide of the mark.
words.example3Translation: Uning taxmini haqiqatdan unchalik uzoq emas edi.

words.translation: muz tog'ining cho'qqisi, muammoning kichik ko'rinadigan qismi
words.definition: A small visible part of a much larger problem. (IELTS ≈ a small part of a bigger problem · only the beginning)
words.definitionUz: the tip of the iceberg — ancha kattaroq muammoning kichik ko'rinadigan qismi.
words.example1: The reported cases are just the tip of the iceberg.
words.example1Translation: Qayd etilgan holatlar muammoning faqat kichik qismi.
words.example2: Many more cases probably exist that have not been reported.
words.example2Translation: Ehtimol, qayd etilmagan ancha ko'p holatlar bor.
words.example3: The fraud discovered so far may be the tip of the iceberg.
words.example3Translation: Hozircha aniqlangan firibgarlik muz tog'ining cho'qqisi bo'lishi mumkin.

words.definition: Not important. (IELTS ≈ unimportant · insignificant · minor · trivial)
words.definitionUz: of little consequence — muhim emas.
words.example1: The error was of little consequence.
words.example1Translation: Xato kam ahamiyatli edi.
words.example2: The mistake did not really matter.
words.example2Translation: Xato aslida muhim emas edi.
words.example3: Such small changes are of little consequence to the overall result.
words.example3Translation: Bunday kichik o'zgarishlar umumiy natija uchun kam ahamiyatli.

words.definition: A sudden, very large improvement. (IELTS ≈ a huge advance · a dramatic improvement · a giant step)
words.definitionUz: a quantum leap — to'satdan juda katta yaxshilanish.
words.example1: The new engine represents a quantum leap in efficiency.
words.example1Translation: Yangi dvigatel samaradorlikda keskin sakrashni anglatadi.
words.example2: The engine is dramatically more efficient than before.
words.example2Translation: Dvigatel avvalgisidan ancha samaraliroq.
words.example3: Smartphones marked a quantum leap in communication.
words.example3Translation: Smartfonlar aloqada keskin sakrashni belgiladi.

words.definition: To seem unimportant when compared with something else. (IELTS ≈ seem trivial by comparison · be dwarfed · fade into nothing)
words.definitionUz: pale into insignificance — boshqa narsa bilan solishtirganda ahamiyatsiz ko'rinmoq.
words.example1: Our problems pale into insignificance beside theirs.
words.example1Translation: Bizning muammolarimiz ularnikiga nisbatan arzimas bo'lib qoladi.
words.example2: Compared with what they face, our troubles seem small.
words.example2Translation: Ular duch kelgan narsa bilan solishtirganda, bizning muammolarimiz kichik ko'rinadi.
words.example3: Earlier floods pale into insignificance compared with this one.
words.example3Translation: Avvalgi suv toshqinlari bu toshqin bilan solishtirganda arzimas.

words.definition: To a large degree. (IELTS ≈ largely · to a great extent · significantly · mainly)
words.definitionUz: in no small measure — katta darajada.
words.example1: The team's success is due in no small measure to its coach.
words.example1Translation: Jamoaning muvaffaqiyati katta darajada murabbiyiga bog'liq.
words.example2: The coach played a very large part in the team's success.
words.example2Translation: Murabbiy jamoa muvaffaqiyatida juda katta rol o'ynadi.
words.example3: The recovery was helped in no small measure by tourism.
words.example3Translation: Tiklanishga turizm katta darajada yordam berdi.

words.definition: Equal in quality or level to something. (IELTS ≈ equal to · comparable with · as good as · level with)
words.definitionUz: on a par with — sifat yoki darajasi bo'yicha biror narsaga teng.
words.example1: The university is now on a par with the best in Europe.
words.example1Translation: Universitet endi Yevropaning eng yaxshilari bilan teng.
words.example2: The university is now as good as Europe's top institutions.
words.example2Translation: Universitet endi Yevropaning yetakchi oliygohlari darajasida.
words.example3: Wages there are not on a par with those in the city.
words.example3Translation: U yerdagi maoshlar shahardagilar bilan teng emas.

words.definition: The most important thing. (IELTS ≈ the most important thing · everything · the ultimate goal)
words.definitionUz: the be-all and end-all — eng muhim narsa.
words.example1: Exam results are not the be-all and end-all of education.
words.example1Translation: Imtihon natijalari ta'limning hammasi emas.
words.example2: Grades are not the only thing that matters in school.
words.example2Translation: Baholar maktabdagi yagona muhim narsa emas.
words.example3: For him, money was the be-all and end-all.
words.example3Translation: Uning uchun pul eng muhim narsa edi.

words.definition: Extremely small. (IELTS ≈ tiny · minute · negligible · microscopic)
words.definitionUz: infinitesimal — nihoyatda kichik.
words.example1: The risk of an accident is infinitesimal.
words.example1Translation: Baxtsiz hodisa xavfi cheksiz kichik.
words.example2: The chance of an accident is extremely small.
words.example2Translation: Baxtsiz hodisa ehtimoli juda kichik.
words.example3: Only an infinitesimal amount of the drug reaches the brain.
words.example3Translation: Dorining faqat cheksiz kichik miqdori miyaga yetib boradi.

words.definition: Very small and not worth much. (IELTS ≈ meagre · trivial · insignificant · measly)
words.definitionUz: paltry — juda kichik va kam qimmatli.
words.example1: Workers received a paltry pay rise of one per cent.
words.example1Translation: Ishchilar bir foizlik arzimas maosh oshishini olishdi.
words.example2: The increase in pay was very small and disappointing.
words.example2Translation: Maoshning oshishi juda kichik va ko'ngilsiz edi.
words.example3: The fine was a paltry sum for such a large company.
words.example3Translation: Jarima bunday yirik kompaniya uchun arzimas summa edi.

words.definition: Remarkably large or impressive. (IELTS ≈ enormous · remarkable · tremendous · extraordinary)
words.definitionUz: prodigious — g'ayrioddiy darajada katta yoki hayratlanarli.
words.example1: The writer produced a prodigious amount of work.
words.example1Translation: Yozuvchi ulkan hajmdagi asarlar yaratdi.
words.example2: She wrote a remarkably large number of books.
words.example2Translation: U hayratlanarli darajada ko'p kitob yozdi.
words.example3: He had a prodigious memory for numbers.
words.example3Translation: Uning raqamlar uchun hayratlanarli xotirasi bor edi.

words.definition: A larger amount or number of something compared with others. (IELTS ≈ majority · predominance · prevalence · bulk)
words.definitionUz: preponderance — boshqalarga nisbatan biror narsaning ko'proq miqdori yoki soni.
words.example1: There is a preponderance of evidence against the theory.
words.example1Translation: Nazariyaga qarshi dalillar ustunlik qiladi.
words.example2: Most of the evidence suggests the theory is wrong.
words.example2Translation: Dalillarning aksariyati nazariya noto'g'ri ekanini ko'rsatadi.
words.example3: The survey found a preponderance of older respondents.
words.example3Translation: So'rovnomada keksa respondentlar ko'pchilikni tashkil etdi.

words.definition: Extremely many. (IELTS ≈ countless · innumerable · numerous · a great many)
words.definitionUz: myriad — nihoyatda ko'p.
words.example1: The internet offers myriad opportunities for learning.
words.example1Translation: Internet o'rganish uchun son-sanoqsiz imkoniyatlar taqdim etadi.
words.example2: There are countless ways to learn online.
words.example2Translation: Onlayn o'rganishning son-sanoqsiz usullari bor.
words.example3: The reef is home to myriad species of fish.
words.example3Translation: Rif son-sanoqsiz baliq turlarining makonidir.

words.definition: Better or greater than anything else. (IELTS ≈ unmatched · unequalled · unrivalled · unprecedented)
words.definitionUz: unparalleled — boshqa har qanday narsadan yaxshiroq yoki kattaroq.
words.example1: The city enjoyed a period of unparalleled prosperity.
words.example1Translation: Shahar tengi yo'q farovonlik davrini boshdan kechirdi.
words.example2: The city was richer than ever before or since.
words.example2Translation: Shahar avval ham, keyin ham bo'lmaganidek boy edi.
words.example3: The view from the summit is unparalleled.
words.example3Translation: Cho'qqidan ko'rinadigan manzara tengsiz.

words.definition: A difference large enough to be noticed. (IELTS ≈ a noticeable difference · a significant change · a measurable difference)
words.definitionUz: an appreciable difference — sezilishi uchun yetarlicha katta farq.
words.example1: The new policy made an appreciable difference to traffic.
words.example1Translation: Yangi siyosat tirbandlikda sezilarli farq yaratdi.
words.example2: Traffic noticeably improved after the policy began.
words.example2Translation: Siyosat boshlangach, tirbandlik sezilarli yaxshilandi.
words.example3: There was no appreciable difference between the two groups.
words.example3Translation: Ikki guruh o'rtasida sezilarli farq yo'q edi.

words.definition: A style of writing that strongly attacks other opinions. (IELTS ≈ an argumentative tone · a combative style · a confrontational voice)
words.definitionUz: a polemical tone — boshqa fikrlarga keskin hujum qiladigan yozuv uslubi.
words.example1: The essay is written in a polemical tone.
words.example1Translation: Insho polemik ohangda yozilgan.
words.example2: The writer strongly attacks the views of opponents.
words.example2Translation: Muallif raqiblarning qarashlariga keskin hujum qiladi.
words.example3: Some readers dislike the book's polemical tone.
words.example3Translation: Ba'zi o'quvchilarga kitobning keskin bahsli ohangi yoqmaydi.

words.definition: Support that is given with some doubts or conditions. (IELTS ≈ partial support · conditional approval · reserved backing)
words.definitionUz: a qualified endorsement — ba'zi shubhalar yoki shartlar bilan berilgan qo'llab-quvvatlash.
words.example1: The report gives the plan a qualified endorsement.
words.example1Translation: Hisobot rejani shartli qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
words.example2: The report supports the plan but has some reservations.
words.example2Translation: Hisobot rejani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, lekin ba'zi e'tirozlari bor.
words.example3: Experts offered only a qualified endorsement of the drug.
words.example3Translation: Mutaxassislar dorini faqat shartli qo'llab-quvvatlashdi.

words.definition: An argument that only repeats the same idea in different words. (IELTS ≈ circular reasoning · a self-repeating argument)
words.definitionUz: a tautological argument — bir xil fikrni turli so'zlar bilan takrorlaydigan dalil.
words.example1: "He is poor because he has no money" is a tautological argument.
words.example1Translation: "U kambag'al, chunki uning puli yo'q" — tavtologik dalil.
words.example2: The statement simply says the same thing twice.
words.example2Translation: Bu gap bir narsani ikki marta aytadi xolos.
words.example3: The examiner criticised the essay for its tautological argument.
words.example3Translation: Imtihon oluvchi inshoni tavtologik dalil uchun tanqid qildi.

words.definition: To treat two different ideas as if they were the same. (IELTS ≈ confuse two ideas · mix up · merge two notions)
words.definitionUz: conflate two concepts — ikki turli g'oyani bir xildek ko'rmoq.
words.example1: Many people conflate two concepts: weather and climate.
words.example1Translation: Ko'p odam ikki tushunchani — ob-havo va iqlimni aralashtirib yuboradi.
words.example2: People often confuse daily weather with long-term climate.
words.example2Translation: Odamlar ko'pincha kundalik ob-havoni uzoq muddatli iqlim bilan adashtiradi.
words.example3: The author conflates two concepts that should be kept separate.
words.example3Translation: Muallif alohida saqlanishi kerak bo'lgan ikki tushunchani aralashtirib yuboradi.

words.definition: An argument that seems correct but is actually wrong. (IELTS ≈ misleading logic · false reasoning · plausible but wrong argument)
words.definitionUz: specious reasoning — to'g'ri ko'rinadigan, lekin aslida noto'g'ri dalil.
words.example1: The advert relies on specious reasoning.
words.example1Translation: Reklama soxta mantiqqa tayanadi.
words.example2: The advert's argument sounds right but is actually false.
words.example2Translation: Reklamadagi dalil to'g'ri eshitiladi, lekin aslida noto'g'ri.
words.example3: Critics exposed the specious reasoning behind the policy.
words.example3Translation: Tanqidchilar siyosat ortidagi soxta mantiqni fosh qilishdi.

words.definition: To show that a position was correct after it was doubted. (IELTS ≈ prove right · justify a position · confirm a view)
words.definitionUz: vindicate a stance — shubha ostida bo'lgan pozitsiyaning to'g'ri ekanini ko'rsatmoq.
words.example1: Later evidence vindicated her stance on the issue.
words.example1Translation: Keyingi dalillar uning bu masaladagi pozitsiyasining to'g'riligini isbotladi.
words.example2: New findings showed that she had been right all along.
words.example2Translation: Yangi topilmalar uning boshidanoq haq bo'lganini ko'rsatdi.
words.example3: The result vindicated the government's cautious stance.
words.example3Translation: Natija hukumatning ehtiyotkor pozitsiyasi to'g'ri ekanini isbotladi.

words.definition: Misrepresenting an opponent's view so that it is easier to attack. (IELTS ≈ distorting an opponent's view · a misrepresentation)
words.definitionUz: a straw man argument — raqibning fikrini hujum qilish osonroq bo'lishi uchun buzib ko'rsatish.
words.example1: Saying vegetarians want to ban all meat is a straw man argument.
words.example1Translation: Vegetarianlar barcha go'shtni taqiqlamoqchi deyish "somon odam" dalilidir.
words.example2: It twists what vegetarians actually believe to make them easy to attack.
words.example2Translation: Bu vegetarianlarning aslida nimaga ishonishini buzib, ularga hujum qilishni osonlashtiradi.
words.example3: Politicians often use a straw man argument in debates.
words.example3Translation: Siyosatchilar munozaralarda ko'pincha "somon odam" dalilidan foydalanadi.

words.translation: savol tug'dirmoq; asosni isbotlamay qabul qilmoq
words.definition: To make people ask a question, or to assume the truth of what is being argued. (IELTS ≈ raise the question · prompt the question · assume the conclusion)
words.definitionUz: beg the question — odamlarni savol berishga undamoq yoki isbotlanayotgan narsani tayyor qabul qilmoq.
words.example1: The rise in prices begs the question of who is responsible.
words.example1Translation: Narxlarning oshishi kim javobgar degan savolni tug'diradi.
words.example2: People naturally want to know who caused the price rise.
words.example2Translation: Odamlar tabiiyki narx oshishiga kim sabab bo'lganini bilishni xohlaydi.
words.example3: His argument begs the question by assuming what it tries to prove.
words.example3Translation: Uning dalili isbotlamoqchi bo'lgan narsasini tayyor qabul qiladi.

words.definition: To argue against an idea, even if you agree with it, to test it. (IELTS ≈ argue the opposite side · challenge for the sake of argument)
words.definitionUz: play devil's advocate — g'oyani sinash uchun, unga qo'shilsangiz ham, unga qarshi bahslashmoq.
words.example1: Let me play devil's advocate: what if the plan fails?
words.example1Translation: Keling, qarama-qarshi tomonni himoya qilay: reja muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa-chi?
words.example2: I will argue against the plan just to test how strong it is.
words.example2Translation: Rejaning qanchalik kuchli ekanini sinash uchun unga qarshi chiqaman.
words.example3: Good teams need someone to play devil's advocate.
words.example3Translation: Yaxshi jamoalarga qarama-qarshi tomonni atayin himoya qiladigan kishi kerak.

words.definition: A question that is open to debate or no longer relevant. (IELTS ≈ a debatable issue · an irrelevant question · an academic point)
words.definitionUz: a moot point — bahsga ochiq yoki endi ahamiyatsiz bo'lgan masala.
words.example1: Whether the plan would have worked is now a moot point.
words.example1Translation: Reja ish bergan bo'larmidi, endi ahamiyatsiz masala.
words.example2: The question no longer matters because the plan was cancelled.
words.example2Translation: Reja bekor qilingani uchun bu savol endi muhim emas.
words.example3: It is a moot point whether the policy was successful.
words.example3Translation: Siyosat muvaffaqiyatli bo'lganmi, bahsli masala.

words.definition: A result that is certain before it happens. (IELTS ≈ a certainty · an inevitable result · a done deal)
words.definitionUz: a foregone conclusion — sodir bo'lishidan oldin aniq bo'lgan natija.
words.example1: The result of the election was a foregone conclusion.
words.example1Translation: Saylov natijasi oldindan ma'lum edi.
words.example2: Everyone knew who would win before the vote took place.
words.example2Translation: Ovoz berishdan oldin hamma kim yutishini bilardi.
words.example3: Do not treat success as a foregone conclusion.
words.example3Translation: Muvaffaqiyatni oldindan ma'lum natija deb hisoblamang.

words.definition: A statement that is too general and ignores exceptions. (IELTS ≈ an overgeneralisation · a blanket statement · a broad claim)
words.definitionUz: a sweeping generalisation — istisnolarni e'tiborsiz qoldiradigan haddan tashqari umumiy gap.
words.example1: Saying all teenagers are lazy is a sweeping generalisation.
words.example1Translation: Barcha o'smirlar dangasa deyish haddan tashqari umumlashtirishdir.
words.example2: The statement unfairly describes every young person the same way.
words.example2Translation: Bu gap har bir yoshni adolatsiz ravishda bir xil ta'riflaydi.
words.example3: Avoid sweeping generalisations in academic writing.
words.example3Translation: Akademik yozuvda haddan tashqari umumlashtirishlardan qoching.

words.definition: The duty to prove that something is true. (IELTS ≈ the obligation to prove · the onus of proof)
words.definitionUz: the burden of proof — biror narsa to'g'ri ekanini isbotlash majburiyati.
words.example1: In court, the burden of proof lies with the prosecution.
words.example1Translation: Sudda isbotlash majburiyati ayblov tomoniga yuklanadi.
words.example2: It is the accusers who must show the person is guilty.
words.example2Translation: Shaxs aybdor ekanini ayblovchilar ko'rsatishi kerak.
words.example3: Those making extraordinary claims bear the burden of proof.
words.example3Translation: G'ayrioddiy da'vo qiluvchilar isbotlash majburiyatini o'z zimmasiga oladi.

words.definition: Attacking the person making an argument instead of the argument itself. (IELTS ≈ a personal attack · attacking the speaker rather than the point)
words.definitionUz: an ad hominem attack — dalilning o'ziga emas, uni aytgan shaxsga hujum qilish.
words.example1: Calling the scientist ugly is an ad hominem attack.
words.example1Translation: Olimni xunuk deb atash shaxsga qaratilgan hujumdir.
words.example2: It attacks the person rather than dealing with her research.
words.example2Translation: Bu uning tadqiqotini muhokama qilish o'rniga shaxsning o'ziga hujum qiladi.
words.example3: The debate descended into ad hominem attacks.
words.example3Translation: Munozara shaxsga qaratilgan hujumlarga aylanib ketdi.

words.definition: To avoid giving a clear answer by using unclear language. (IELTS ≈ be vague · evade the question · hedge · prevaricate)
words.definitionUz: equivocate — noaniq til ishlatib, aniq javob berishdan qochmoq.
words.example1: The minister equivocated when asked about the cuts.
words.example1Translation: Vazir qisqartirishlar haqida so'ralganda aniq javobdan qochdi.
words.example2: He avoided giving a straight answer about the reductions.
words.example2Translation: U qisqartirishlar haqida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob berishdan qochdi.
words.example3: Stop equivocating and tell us what you think.
words.example3Translation: Aniq javobdan qochishni bas qiling va nima deb o'ylashingizni ayting.

words.definition: Pretending to be honest or innocent when you are not. (IELTS ≈ insincere · dishonest · hypocritical · deceitful)
words.definitionUz: disingenuous — aslida unday bo'lmay, halol yoki begunoh bo'lib ko'rinadigan.
words.example1: It is disingenuous to claim the tax will help the poor.
words.example1Translation: Soliq kambag'allarga yordam beradi deb da'vo qilish samimiy emas.
words.example2: The speaker knows the tax will not really help the poor.
words.example2Translation: Notiq soliq aslida kambag'allarga yordam bermasligini biladi.
words.example3: Critics called the company's apology disingenuous.
words.example3Translation: Tanqidchilar kompaniyaning kechirim so'rashini samimiy emas deb atashdi.

words.definition: Expressing a strong, often controversial opinion in a biased way. (IELTS ≈ biased · one-sided · partisan · slanted)
words.definitionUz: tendentious — ko'pincha bahsli fikrni bir tomonlama ifodalaydigan.
words.example1: The documentary was criticised as tendentious.
words.example1Translation: Hujjatli film bir tomonlama deb tanqid qilindi.
words.example2: The film only showed one side of the argument.
words.example2Translation: Film bahsning faqat bir tomonini ko'rsatdi.
words.example3: His tendentious reading of history ignores key facts.
words.example3Translation: Uning tarixni bir tomonlama talqini asosiy faktlarni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi.

words.definition: Based on a mistaken belief or faulty reasoning. (IELTS ≈ false · mistaken · invalid · erroneous)
words.definitionUz: fallacious — noto'g'ri e'tiqod yoki xato mulohazaga asoslangan.
words.example1: The argument is fallacious because it confuses cause and effect.
words.example1Translation: Bu dalil noto'g'ri, chunki u sabab va oqibatni chalkashtiradi.
words.example2: The reasoning is wrong because it mixes up what causes what.
words.example2Translation: Mulohaza noto'g'ri, chunki u nima nimaga sabab bo'lishini adashtiradi.
words.example3: The claim rests on a fallacious assumption.
words.example3Translation: Da'vo noto'g'ri taxminga asoslangan.

words.definition: Insisting that your beliefs are right without considering other opinions. (IELTS ≈ inflexible · rigid · opinionated · doctrinaire)
words.definitionUz: dogmatic — boshqa fikrlarni hisobga olmasdan o'z e'tiqodlari to'g'ri ekanini ta'kidlaydigan.
words.example1: The professor was dogmatic about his theory.
words.example1Translation: Professor o'z nazariyasi borasida o'z fikridan qaytmasdi.
words.example2: He refused to consider any view different from his own.
words.example2Translation: U o'zinikidan farqli har qanday qarashni ko'rib chiqishni rad etdi.
words.example3: Science should not be dogmatic.
words.example3Translation: Fan aqidaparast bo'lmasligi kerak.

words.definition: Clear, direct and showing sharp intelligence. (IELTS ≈ sharp · penetrating · perceptive · astute)
words.definitionUz: incisive — aniq, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri va o'tkir aqlni ko'rsatadigan.
words.example1: The journalist asked a series of incisive questions.
words.example1Translation: Jurnalist bir qator o'tkir savollar berdi.
words.example2: Her questions went straight to the heart of the issue.
words.example2Translation: Uning savollari masalaning mohiyatiga to'g'ri borib tegdi.
words.example3: The report offers an incisive analysis of the problem.
words.example3Translation: Hisobot muammoning o'tkir tahlilini taqdim etadi.

words.definition: To be a typical example or symbol of something. (IELTS ≈ symbolise · typify · represent · epitomise)
words.definitionUz: be emblematic of — biror narsaning tipik namunasi yoki ramzi bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The empty factories are emblematic of the town's decline.
words.example1Translation: Bo'sh zavodlar shahar tanazzulining ramzidir.
words.example2: The abandoned factories show clearly how the town has declined.
words.example2Translation: Tashlandiq zavodlar shahar qanday tanazzulga uchraganini aniq ko'rsatadi.
words.example3: The dispute is emblematic of wider tensions in society.
words.example3Translation: Nizo jamiyatdagi kengroq ziddiyatlarning ramzidir.

words.definition: To make something deliberately unclear or difficult to understand. (IELTS ≈ obscure · confuse · cloud · muddy)
words.definitionUz: obfuscate — biror narsani ataylab noaniq yoki tushunish qiyin qilmoq.
words.example1: The company used technical language to obfuscate the risks.
words.example1Translation: Kompaniya xavflarni chalkashtirish uchun texnik tildan foydalandi.
words.example2: The firm hid the dangers behind complicated words.
words.example2Translation: Firma xavflarni murakkab so'zlar ortiga yashirdi.
words.example3: Politicians sometimes obfuscate rather than answer questions.
words.example3Translation: Siyosatchilar ba'zan savollarga javob berish o'rniga chalkashtiradi.

words.definition: To be based on a particular idea or belief. (IELTS ≈ be based on · rest on · depend on · be founded on)
words.definitionUz: be predicated on — ma'lum g'oya yoki e'tiqodga asoslangan bo'lmoq.
words.example1: The plan is predicated on continued economic growth.
words.example1Translation: Reja doimiy iqtisodiy o'sishga asoslangan.
words.example2: The plan only works if the economy keeps growing.
words.example2Translation: Reja faqat iqtisodiyot o'sishda davom etsa ishlaydi.
words.example3: The theory is predicated on a false assumption.
words.example3Translation: Nazariya noto'g'ri taxminga asoslangan.

words.definition: To say you support something without doing anything to help it. (IELTS ≈ support in words only · give token support to · pretend to support)
words.definitionUz: pay lip service to — biror narsani yordam berish uchun hech narsa qilmasdan, faqat so'zda qo'llab-quvvatlamoq.
words.example1: Many companies pay lip service to protecting the environment.
words.example1Translation: Ko'plab kompaniyalar atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilishni faqat so'zda qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
words.example2: They talk about the environment but do very little.
words.example2Translation: Ular atrof-muhit haqida gapiradi, lekin juda kam ish qiladi.
words.example3: The government only paid lip service to reform.
words.example3Translation: Hukumat islohotni faqat so'zda qo'llab-quvvatladi.

words.definition: For longer than anyone can remember. (IELTS ≈ since ancient times · for ages · since the beginning)
words.definitionUz: from time immemorial — hech kim eslay olmaydigan vaqtdan beri.
words.example1: People have grown grapes in this valley from time immemorial.
words.example1Translation: Bu vodiyda odamlar qadim-qadimdan uzum yetishtirib kelishadi.
words.example2: Grapes have been farmed here for as long as anyone knows.
words.example2Translation: Bu yerda uzum hech kim bilmaydigan zamonlardan beri yetishtiriladi.
words.example3: From time immemorial, humans have told stories.
words.example3Translation: Qadim-qadimdan odamlar hikoyalar aytib kelgan.

words.definition: For ever. (IELTS ≈ for ever · permanently · for all time · eternally)
words.definitionUz: in perpetuity — abadiy.
words.example1: The land was given to the city in perpetuity.
words.example1Translation: Yer shaharga abadiy berildi.
words.example2: The city will own the land for ever.
words.example2Translation: Shahar yerga abadiy egalik qiladi.
words.example3: The rights to the song were sold in perpetuity.
words.example3Translation: Qo'shiq huquqlari cheksiz muddatga sotildi.

words.definition: A discovery so important that it begins a new period in history. (IELTS ≈ a landmark discovery · a world-changing find)
words.definitionUz: an epoch-making discovery — tarixda yangi davr boshlaydigan darajada muhim kashfiyot.
words.example1: The discovery of penicillin was an epoch-making discovery.
words.example1Translation: Penitsillinning kashf etilishi davr ochuvchi kashfiyot bo'ldi.
words.example2: Penicillin changed medicine and began a new era.
words.example2Translation: Penitsillin tibbiyotni o'zgartirib, yangi davrni boshlab berdi.
words.example3: Many consider the internet an epoch-making invention.
words.example3Translation: Ko'pchilik internetni davr ochuvchi ixtiro deb hisoblaydi.

words.definition: Not changing for thousands of years. (IELTS ≈ unchanged for thousands of years · constant over time)
words.definitionUz: immutable over millennia — ming yillar davomida o'zgarmagan.
words.example1: The basic design of the boat has been immutable over millennia.
words.example1Translation: Qayiqning asosiy dizayni ming yillar davomida o'zgarmagan.
words.example2: Boats like this have been built the same way for thousands of years.
words.example2Translation: Bunday qayiqlar ming yillar davomida bir xil usulda qurilgan.
words.example3: Some laws of nature appear immutable over millennia.
words.example3Translation: Tabiatning ba'zi qonunlari ming yillar davomida o'zgarmas ko'rinadi.

words.definition: The final result of a development that lasted hundreds of years. (IELTS ≈ the climax of centuries of development · the end result of long history)
words.definitionUz: the culmination of centuries — yuzlab yillar davom etgan rivojlanishning yakuniy natijasi.
words.example1: The cathedral was the culmination of centuries of building skill.
words.example1Translation: Sobor asrlar davomidagi qurilish mahoratining cho'qqisi edi.
words.example2: The church represents hundreds of years of developing techniques.
words.example2Translation: Cherkov yuzlab yillar davomida rivojlangan usullarni aks ettiradi.
words.example3: Modern democracy is the culmination of centuries of struggle.
words.example3Translation: Zamonaviy demokratiya asrlar davomidagi kurashning cho'qqisidir.

words.definition: A long period without growth or development. (IELTS ≈ prolonged inactivity · a long slump · extended standstill)
words.definitionUz: protracted stagnation — o'sish yoki rivojlanishsiz uzoq davr.
words.example1: The economy suffered from protracted stagnation in the 1990s.
words.example1Translation: 1990-yillarda iqtisodiyot uzoq davom etgan turg'unlikdan aziyat chekdi.
words.example2: The economy did not grow for many years.
words.example2Translation: Iqtisodiyot ko'p yillar davomida o'smadi.
words.example3: Protracted stagnation led to high youth unemployment.
words.example3Translation: Uzoq davom etgan turg'unlik yoshlar orasida yuqori ishsizlikka olib keldi.

words.definition: The tendency to believe, after an event, that you could have predicted it. (IELTS ≈ the knew-it-all-along effect · retrospective bias)
words.definitionUz: hindsight bias — voqeadan keyin uni oldindan aytib bera olardim deb ishonishga moyillik.
words.example1: Hindsight bias makes past crises seem obvious.
words.example1Translation: Orqaga nazar xatosi o'tmishdagi inqirozlarni aniq ko'rsatadi.
words.example2: After it happens, a crisis seems easy to have predicted.
words.example2Translation: Inqiroz yuz bergandan keyin uni oldindan aytish oson bo'lgandek tuyuladi.
words.example3: Investors often suffer from hindsight bias.
words.example3Translation: Investorlar ko'pincha orqaga nazar xatosidan aziyat chekadi.

words.definition: Eventually, when the right time comes. (IELTS ≈ eventually · in due course · sooner or later · ultimately)
words.definitionUz: in the fullness of time — oxir-oqibat, vaqti kelganda.
words.example1: The truth will emerge in the fullness of time.
words.example1Translation: Haqiqat vaqti kelib oshkor bo'ladi.
words.example2: Eventually, everyone will know what really happened.
words.example2Translation: Oxir-oqibat hamma nima bo'lganini biladi.
words.example3: In the fullness of time, the project will pay for itself.
words.example3Translation: Vaqti kelib loyiha o'zini oqlaydi.

words.definition: Customs that have been respected for a very long time. (IELTS ≈ long-standing customs · ancient traditions · established practices)
words.definitionUz: time-honoured traditions — juda uzoq vaqtdan beri hurmat qilinadigan odatlar.
words.example1: The festival preserves time-honoured traditions.
words.example1Translation: Festival azaliy an'analarni saqlaydi.
words.example2: The celebration keeps very old customs alive.
words.example2Translation: Bayram juda eski odatlarni tirik saqlaydi.
words.example3: Families still follow time-honoured traditions at weddings.
words.example3Translation: Oilalar to'ylarda hamon azaliy an'analarga amal qiladi.

words.definition: A temporary solution until a better one is found. (IELTS ≈ a temporary fix · a short-term solution · a makeshift measure)
words.definitionUz: a stopgap measure — yaxshiroq yechim topilguncha vaqtinchalik yechim.
words.example1: The emergency loan is only a stopgap measure.
words.example1Translation: Favqulodda qarz faqat vaqtinchalik chora.
words.example2: The loan will help for now but will not solve the problem.
words.example2Translation: Qarz hozircha yordam beradi, lekin muammoni hal qilmaydi.
words.example3: Tents were used as a stopgap measure after the earthquake.
words.example3Translation: Zilziladan keyin vaqtinchalik chora sifatida chodirlardan foydalanildi.

words.definition: At the last possible moment. (IELTS ≈ at the last minute · just in time · at the final moment)
words.definitionUz: at the eleventh hour — mumkin bo'lgan eng so'nggi lahzada.
words.example1: The deal was signed at the eleventh hour.
words.example1Translation: Kelishuv so'nggi daqiqada imzolandi.
words.example2: The agreement was reached just before the deadline.
words.example2Translation: Kelishuvga muddat tugashidan oldingina erishildi.
words.example3: The strike was called off at the eleventh hour.
words.example3Translation: Ish tashlash so'nggi daqiqada bekor qilindi.

words.definition: The beginning of a period or development. (IELTS ≈ the beginning of · the start of · the birth of · the emergence of)
words.definitionUz: the dawn of — davr yoki rivojlanishning boshlanishi.
words.example1: Since the dawn of civilisation, people have traded goods.
words.example1Translation: Sivilizatsiya tongidan beri odamlar tovar ayirboshlab kelishgan.
words.example2: People have traded since civilisation first began.
words.example2Translation: Odamlar sivilizatsiya boshlanganidan beri savdo qilib kelishadi.
words.example3: We are at the dawn of a new age of space travel.
words.example3Translation: Biz koinot sayohatining yangi davri tongidamiz.

words.definition: During the time that people still alive can remember. (IELTS ≈ in recent memory · in the lifetime of people still alive)
words.definitionUz: within living memory — hozir tirik bo'lgan odamlar eslay oladigan vaqt ichida.
words.example1: This is the worst flood within living memory.
words.example1Translation: Bu hozir yashayotganlar xotirasidagi eng dahshatli suv toshqini.
words.example2: Nobody alive today remembers a worse flood.
words.example2Translation: Bugun tirik bo'lgan hech kim bundan yomonroq toshqinni eslamaydi.
words.example3: Within living memory, the village had no electricity.
words.example3Translation: Hozir yashayotganlar xotirasida qishloqda elektr bo'lmagan.

words.definition: Disappearing quickly; lasting only a short time. (IELTS ≈ fleeting · transient · short-lived · momentary)
words.definitionUz: evanescent — tez yo'qoladigan; qisqa vaqt davom etadigan.
words.example1: The beauty of cherry blossom is evanescent.
words.example1Translation: Gilos gulining go'zalligi tez o'tib ketuvchi.
words.example2: The flowers are beautiful but last only a few days.
words.example2Translation: Gullar chiroyli, lekin bir necha kungina turadi.
words.example3: Online trends are often evanescent.
words.example3Translation: Onlayn tendensiyalar ko'pincha o'tkinchi bo'ladi.

words.definition: The happening of events at the same time in a way that seems meaningful. (IELTS ≈ meaningful coincidence · simultaneity · coincidence)
words.definitionUz: synchronicity — voqealarning bir vaqtda, ma'noli tuyuladigan tarzda sodir bo'lishi.
words.example1: By strange synchronicity, both inventors had the same idea in the same year.
words.example1Translation: G'alati tasodif bilan ikkala ixtirochi ham bir yilda bir xil g'oyaga kelishdi.
words.example2: Two people came up with the same invention at exactly the same time.
words.example2Translation: Ikki kishi aynan bir vaqtda bir xil ixtiroga kelishdi.
words.example3: The synchronicity of the events seemed more than chance.
words.example3Translation: Voqealarning bir vaqtga to'g'ri kelishi tasodifdan ko'proq tuyuldi.

words.definition: Former. (IELTS ≈ former · previous · one-time · onetime)
words.definitionUz: erstwhile — sobiq.
words.example1: The two erstwhile enemies signed a peace agreement.
words.example1Translation: Ikki sobiq dushman tinchlik kelishuvini imzoladi.
words.example2: Countries that used to fight each other made peace.
words.example2Translation: Ilgari urushgan davlatlar tinchlik o'rnatdi.
words.example3: The building is the erstwhile home of the poet.
words.example3Translation: Bino shoirning sobiq uyidir.

words.definition: Lasting only for a short time. (IELTS ≈ temporary · brief · fleeting · short-lived)
words.definitionUz: transitory — faqat qisqa vaqt davom etadigan.
words.example1: The benefits of the policy proved transitory.
words.example1Translation: Siyosatning foydalari o'tkinchi bo'lib chiqdi.
words.example2: The good effects of the policy did not last long.
words.example2Translation: Siyosatning yaxshi ta'siri uzoq davom etmadi.
words.example3: Fame is often transitory.
words.example3Translation: Shuhrat ko'pincha o'tkinchi bo'ladi.

words.definition: To have a lasting effect on something that cannot be removed. (IELTS ≈ have a permanent effect on · leave a lasting impression on)
words.definitionUz: leave an indelible mark on — biror narsaga o'chirib bo'lmaydigan uzoq ta'sir ko'rsatmoq.
words.example1: The war left an indelible mark on the country.
words.example1Translation: Urush mamlakatda o'chmas iz qoldirdi.
words.example2: The country was permanently changed by the war.
words.example2Translation: Mamlakat urush tufayli butunlay o'zgardi.
words.example3: Her teaching left an indelible mark on her students.
words.example3Translation: Uning o'qitishi shogirdlarida o'chmas iz qoldirdi.

words.definition: Until now or until a particular time. (IELTS ≈ until now · previously · so far · up to now)
words.definitionUz: hitherto — hozirgacha yoki ma'lum vaqtgacha.
words.example1: The study revealed a hitherto unknown species.
words.example1Translation: Tadqiqot shu paytgacha noma'lum bo'lgan turni aniqladi.
words.example2: Researchers found a species that nobody had known about before.
words.example2Translation: Tadqiqotchilar ilgari hech kim bilmagan turni topishdi.
words.example3: Hitherto, the problem had been ignored.
words.example3Translation: Shu paytgacha muammo e'tiborsiz qoldirilgan edi.
